title: John Abraham joins Indian Superbike League as Strategic Advisor: "It’s time to get India racing"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

With John Abraham at the centre of its launch, ISBL brings together motorsport, entertainment and pop culture to introduce a new sporting proposition to India. The movie marks the first major expression of ISBL’s identity as a sport-meets-entertainment property, built around performance, technology, personalities, competition and India’s enduring motorcycle culture.

Adding to this, Speaking about his association with ISBL, John Abraham, Strategic Advisor, Indian Superbike League, shared, "Motorcycles have always been a deeply personal passion. Being a sports team owner has also taught me what it takes to turn belief into sustained commitment. ISBL brings those two parts of my life together. I want to help young Indian riders get the opportunities they deserve and share the thrill of motorcycle racing with a whole new generation of followers. It’s time to Get India Racing.”
Meanwhile, A post shared by Indian Superbike League (@indiansuperbikeleague)

Notably, Pranav Bakre, CEO, Indian Superbike League, shared, “I come from a family of racers, so building ISBL is deeply personal. My ambition is to carry that legacy forward by creating something that opens doors for the next generation. I want people to feel the excitement of racing that has stayed with my family for decades. With racing at its heart, and music and culture bringing more people into its world, ISBL is how I want to make that happen.”

As per the latest buzz, Avi Jain, Managing Director, Dhuleva Group and Anchor Investor, ISBL, shared, “My passion for motoring draws me to racing. As an investor, what excites me is the opportunity to build a business around it that creates lasting value. With ISBL, our ambition is to build a premium, commercially sustainable league that followers return to and partners want to grow with, season after season.”

In further updates, Sanctioned by the Federation of Motor Sports Clubs of India (FMSCI), ISBL will operate as a franchise-based championship featuring two Pro categories, Amateur, Female Riders and Rookie classes. ISBL aims to create a structured competitive environment for riders while opening opportunities across teams, technical personnel, brands, creators and the wider motorsport ecosystem.
On top of that, Further details on teams, riders, race formats and venues will be revealed in due course.

title: HYBE INDIA AUDITION: Final call enters final 5 days as applications close on October 31
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The HYBE INDIA AUDITION began on March 31, with applications open until July 31 and an audition tour spanning 15 cities across India and international markets. Following the response to the audition, HYBE INDIA introduced the Final Call in September, expanding the search to eight additional cities across India. Rooted in the belief that talent can be found anywhere, the expansion aimed to go deeper into the country, reaching aspiring performers across cities, towns and communities and creating more opportunities for young women to take their first step towards the global stage. The HYBE INDIA Pop-up Parks also offered another avenue for talent to audition, taking the search beyond conventional application channels and into cultural and fan engagement spaces.

Adding to this, HYBE INDIA also collaborated with Pan-India star Rashmika Mandanna for the HYBE INDIA Audition: Final Call, with the star sharing a heartwarming video recounting her own journey and inspiring young girls to pursue their dreams, believe in their potential and discover their own universe of possibilities.

Meanwhile, As the audition enters its final days, the focus is on ensuring that aspiring performers who have been considering applying do not miss their last chance to be part of the search. The initiative invites female participants born between 2005 and 2011 across India and the global Indian diaspora to showcase their abilities across vocals, rap, dance and performance.

Notably, The search looks beyond developed talent to identify individuality, star quality and potential that can be nurtured over time through HYBE’s global artist development ecosystem. The vision is to bring together diverse cultural influences and emerging talent from across India to develop a new girl group capable of connecting with audiences across cultures and borders.

As per the latest buzz, With the application window closing on October 31, this is the final opportunity for aspiring performers to take their first step towards a potential career on the global stage. Those who have been waiting for the right moment to showcase their talent are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

In further updates, Online applications for the HYBE INDIA AUDITION: FINAL CALL close on October 31. Eligibility criteria, application details and participation guidelines are available on the official HYBE INDIA audition website. (https://india.hybeaudition.com/)

title: Anupam Kher to play Sunil Munshi’s father in Swedish-Belgian film Out of Fashion, directed by Jens Jonsson

title: CBFC faces reported data security scare as confidential documents linked to over 500 films are allegedly exposed
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

As per the latest buzz, the documents remained accessible through digital archiving platforms for several days before the alleged exposure came to light. Although the actual movie files were as per reports not leaked, the availability of confidential records has prompted questions about the security measures in place to protect filmmakers' intellectual property and commercially sensitive information.

Adding to this, The documents allegedly exposed include scripts of unreleased films, details of cuts and modifications recommended during the certification process, and other material associated with movie submissions. The reported exposure of scripts is a particular concern for filmmakers, as the premature disclosure of storylines, plot developments and key scenes could affect projects before their theatrical or digital rollout.

Meanwhile, Additionally, information about scenes that were marked for deletion or modification during the certification process could become publicly accessible. Such details may reveal creative decisions and aspects of a movie that filmmakers intended to keep confidential until its rollout.

Notably, The e-Cinepramaan portal is the CBFC's online platform through which filmmakers and production houses submit applications for movie certification before releasing their projects. The system facilitates the certification process by allowing applicants to share the required documents and information digitally.

As per the latest buzz, The alleged exposure has raised concerns about the safeguards governing the information submitted through the portal. Filmmakers depend on confidentiality during the certification process, particularly when dealing with unreleased content and material that has not yet been made available to the public.
In further updates, Distribution Agreements and Licensing Details Also As per reports Exposed

On top of that, Beyond scripts and censor-related documents, the alleged incident has as per reports involved private distribution agreements and licensing fee details connected to domestic and international movie projects.

These records may contain commercially sensitive information, including revenue-sharing arrangements, intellectual property clauses and contractual terms negotiated between production houses, distributors and licensing partners. If such information becomes accessible to unauthorised parties, it could raise concerns about the confidentiality of business negotiations and agreements within the entertainment industry.

title: HT Evening News Brief October 26: Cyclone Arnab intensifies, Jamia protests continue, E100 cars get conditional nod
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Good evening! Here's your 5-minute wrap of the day's top headlines from across the country, the world of politics and sports, and entertainment.

Adding to this, The university revoked some disciplinary notices, but protesters shared several demands remained unresolved. ((Arvind Yadav/Hindustan Times)) Jamia protests continue after student union election announcement Students at Jamia Millia Islamia continued protesting on Monday, hours after the university opened up that student union elections would be held within 15 days of approval of the union constitution. Protesters demanded the appointment of a chief election officer and a clear timeline for the polls. Delhi Police detained several students as tensions continued on campus. The university revoked some disciplinary notices, but protesters shared several demands remained unresolved. Read more .

Meanwhile, The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules to recognise E100 as an approved fuel option alongside E85 for flex-fuel vehicles. The notification was issued on October 23 and published in the official gazette on October 26, taking immediate effect. Flex-fuel vehicles can run on different mixtures of petrol and ethanol, but conventional petrol vehicles cannot use these higher blends without appropriate certification and modifications. Read more .

Notably, Cyclone Arnab is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm before crossing the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on October 28, according to the India Meteorological Department. Red alerts have been issued for parts of Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, while heavy rainfall is forecast in several states. Disaster response teams have been deployed, and authorities are preparing to evacuate vulnerable residents ahead of the storm. Read more .

As per the latest buzz, Star Vijay Deverakonda has responded to online criticism of his relationship with Rashmika Mandanna following their appearance on *Koffee With Karan 9*. Sharing a photo and video with Rashmika, Vijay described her as his best friend and shared they were happy together, while using strong language to address critics. Rashmika had also issued a statement defending their relationship and responding to the backlash over their remarks on the show. Read more .

title: Kriti Sanon, Varun Dhawan wolf howl as they reunite with Bhediya director Amar Kaushik; fans wonder if sequel is underway
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood actors Kriti Sanon , Varun Dhawan and director Amar Kaushik are back together, and followers want to know why. The trio, who worked together on Bhediya in 2022, have sparked fresh speculation after Kriti shared a video of herself with Varun and Amar on social media. While the three have not revealed what brought them together, her caption has left followers wondering if they are planning something new.

Adding to this, Bhediya 2 or a new movie? Kriti Sanon, Varun Dhawan and Amar Kaushik's reunion sparks speculation. Kriti Sanon shares reunion video Kriti took to her Instagram Stories on Monday to share a video that Varun reposted. Sharing the video, Kriti wrote, “An unexpected reunion that will get you ‘Obsessed’! 😜🤭🤭 Stay Tuned!! ❤️.” The mention of "obsessed" has caught everyone's attention, with followers trying to figure out what the trio could be hinting at. Could this be about Bhediya 2, given that they howl in the video, or are they coming together for something completely different? There is no official confirmation yet.

Meanwhile, Kriti, Varun and Amar previously worked together on Bhediya, which hit theatres in November 2022. The horror-comedy followed Bhaskar, played by Varun, a road-construction contractor who is bitten by a wolf while working in the forests of Arunachal Pradesh. He soon begins experiencing a strange transformation into a werewolf. Kriti played Anika, a veterinarian who knows more about the mysterious events than she initially lets on.

Notably, Directed by Amar Kaushik, who also made Stree, Bhediya mixed supernatural elements with humour and local folklore. The movie also touched upon environmental concerns, using its werewolf story to explore the relationship between humans and nature. Its visual effects and quirky humour helped it stand out in the horror comedy space and become part of the Maddock Supernatural Universe. Bhediya collected ₹ 94.41 crore rupees worldwide in its lifetime, as per Sacnilk.

As per the latest buzz, Varun had even made a cameo in Stree 2 in 2024, where his character saves Shraddha Kapoor's character. Back in 2025, the production house Maddock Films revealed a slate of soon-to-release releases, and Bhediya 2 was officially revealed for an August 2026 rollout. But, as projects got postponed, there has been no update since then.

In further updates, Both Kriti and Varun have a busy slate of projects. Varun Dhawan was most of late seen in Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai. Before that, he starred in Border 2. Kriti Sanon also had two releases last year. She was seen in Tere Ishk Mein and most of late, Cocktail 2.

On top of that, Recent reports opened up that Kriti Sanon may be entering another horror space in Maddock Films' universe, which will be written by star Sadia Khateeb. Meanwhile, Varun is as per reports in talks to star in Yash Raj Films' first-ever horror feature movie, directed by Abhay Pannu.

A source close to the project told Hindustan Times earlier this year, “Varun has come on board as the lead for YRF’s first horror movie. Yash Raj Films (YRF) is entering the horror genre for the first time.” If things fall into place, this will be the star's first collaboration with YRF since the 2018 slice-of-life drama Sui Dhaaga, which also starred Anushka Sharma.

title: Raveena Tandon turns 54: When she cleaned studio floors as an intern, rejected films with Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Raveena Tandon's journey in Bollywood has been nothing short of extraordinary. Becoming an star was never part of her original plan, but she went on to become one of the leading female stars of the 1990s and an icon. From interning with ad filmmaker Prahlad Kakkar and cleaning studio floors to turning down several movie offers, including Darr and Prem Qaidi, Raveena took her time finding her way into the industry. She eventually made her debut opposite Salman Khan in Patthar Ke Phool (1991).

Adding to this, Despite being the daughter of filmmaker Ravi Tandon, Raveena began her professional journey behind the camera. In an interview with Mid-Day in 2022, she recalled assisting ad filmmaker Prahlad Kakkar soon after completing Class 10. While interning with him, she realised she could take up modelling and earn some pocket money.

Meanwhile, She shared, "I did start from cleaning the studio floors to wiping off vomit from the stalls floors and studio floors and stuff, and I did assist Prahlad Kakkar I think straight out of 10th Standard. Everytime when a model would not turn up on Prahlad's set, he used to say 'call Raveena,' he would ask me to do my makeup and start posing. So I thought if I have to do it why should I do it for Prahlad again and again for free, why not make some pocket money out of it, and that's exactly the thought which started the modeling. So I am in this industry actually by default, never grew up thinking that I am going to be an star."

Notably, Raveena shared that during her modelling stint, she kept receiving movie offers, but acting was not something she actively sought. In another interview, the star spoke about turning down several films, including those featuring leading stars.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking on ANI's podcast in 2023, she opened up that she was the first choice for Yash Chopra's Darr, which eventually starred Shah Rukh Khan, Sunny Deol and Juhi Chawla. However, she turned it down because she was uncomfortable with certain scenes. She shared, “Darr came to me first. It wasn't vulgar, but there were some scenes I was not comfortable with. There were things like wearing a swimming costume, and I would say, 'No, I'll not wear that.'”

In further updates, In the same conversation, Raveena shared that Prem Qaidi, which marked Karisma Kapoor's Bollywood debut, had also been offered to her. However, she turned it down because a particular scene made her uncomfortable. These were not the only films Raveena turned down. She also rejected Phool Aur Kaante, Ajay Devgn's debut movie, as she was unsure whether she wanted to pursue acting.

On top of that, Raveena eventually agreed to make her debut with Patthar Ke Phool, opposite Salman Khan. In an interview with Lehren in 2023, she recalled how her friend and fellow model Bunty Walia encouraged Salman to meet her after learning that the Dabangg star was looking for a fresh face.

Recalling how her debut movie came about, Raveena shared, "At that time, Bunty Walia, who was a friend of mine and a co-model on an ad, called Salman and shared ‘You have to meet this girl and I think she is the next big thing and you are looking for a new girl.’ Salman separately came to see my work. I think it was destiny."

title: Fresh protests erupt at Jamia Millia Islamia hours after election announcement; students detained
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hours after Delhi's Jamia Millia Islamia revealed the resumption of student union elections after a nearly two-decade hiatus, fresh protests erupted on campus on Monday as students demanded a time-bound election process and the appointment of a chief election officer.

Adding to this, Students of Jamia Millia Islamia stage a protest demanding entry to their campus amid an ongoing strike, as security personnel allow only hostel residents to enter the campus in New Delhi. ( Arvind Yadav/ Hindustan Times) Earlier in the day, around 100 female students entered the campus through different gates, with some gathering outside Gate no. 7, while several protesters were also detained by the Delhi Police. The students raised slogans of “Delhi Police, go back” as tensions continued over the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union (JMISU), whose elections have not been held since 2006.

Meanwhile, “We want the administration to appoint a chief election officer and fast-track the election process. Until then, the protest will continue,” Asif Khan, a student at JMI’s Faculty of Law, told HT.
Notably, The absence of an elected student body has left students without an effective channel to communicate their grievances to the university administration, a 20-year-old student told HT.

As per the latest buzz, “From admissions to hostel seats to food in the mess, there is a problem with everything at Jamia. We don’t have anyone between us, the students, and the Jamia administration. We want a union to bridge that gap,” the student shared.

In further updates, On Monday, the university administration opened up that student union elections would be held within 15 days of the approval of the students’ union constitution, HT reported earlier.

On top of that, The announcement came after nearly two weeks of protests and hunger strikes on campus over the restoration of the JMISU. The decision followed nearly five hours of negotiations between student representatives and university officials. The administration also revoked suspension orders and show-cause notices issued to some students and assured an inquiry into the conduct of security personnel during the protests.

“The Jamia Millia Islamia Students Union Election will be held after 15 days, from the date of approval of the constitution of the students’ union. Suspension and show-cause notices issued to students are hereby revoked. A committee shall be constituted to enquire into the actions of security staff during the period of protest,” JMI registrar Professor Mahtab Alam Rizvi shared in a note.

title: Yash to handle Karnataka distribution of Ranbir Kapoor starrer Ramayana under Monster Mind Creations
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star, who plays Ravana and co-produces the movie, has expanded his banner’s operations with a dedicated theatrical distribution wing for the Karnataka market.

Adding to this, With Yash commanding a substantial following in Karnataka and across India, Monster Mind Creations’ involvement in the regional distribution of Ramayana is expected to play an important role in shaping the movie’s theatrical rollout in the state. The arrangement places the star’s own banner at the centre of the movie’s Karnataka rollout strategy, as the makers work towards bringing the ambitious mythological drama to audiences across multiple markets.

Meanwhile, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, known for films such as Dangal and Chhichhore , Ramayana is being developed as a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic. The movie features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble brings together prominent actors from different movie industries for a project mounted on a large scale.

Notably, The Karnataka distribution arrangement forms part of a wider rollout strategy involving established partners across domestic and international territories. Sony Pictures is handling international distribution, while Dharma Productions will oversee the Hindi-speaking markets in North India. Telugu producer Dil Raju is associated with distribution across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, while Think Studios will handle Tamil Nadu. E4 Entertainment, led by Mukesh Mehta, is responsible for the Kerala market.

As per the latest buzz, Jointly produced by Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is being envisioned as a large-scale theatrical experience, with visual effects and production design forming key aspects of its cinematic presentation. Yash’s dual involvement as an star and producer, alongside his banner’s distribution responsibilities in Karnataka, further expands his role in the project.

In further updates, Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical rollout on November 5, 2026, across multiple languages and premium large formats. With the Karnataka distribution now assigned to Monster Mind Creations, the movie’s rollout plans continue to take shape across regional and international markets.

title: Madhoo is in love with Rashmika Mandanna owning her South Indian accent on Koffee With Karan; recalls being judged for it in Bollywood
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Madhoo , who has acted in all South Indian languages and Hindi, spoke up in support of Rashmika Mandanna owning her accent on Karan Johar’s talk show, Koffee With Karan. Recalling feeling judged for the same when she worked in Bollywood, the star shared that it took her over 30 years to be comfortable with her accent, as Rashmika is today. In a video posted on her Instagram, Madhoo also shared that she had to work extra hard to mask her accent when working in Hindi films.

Adding to this, In a long video posted on her Instagram, Madhoo remarked that she watched Rashmika’s KWK episode. “The way she dealt with her accent, criticism, I just loved it. She laughs about it, she accepts it, she owns it. Calls herself a South Indian. And she says, so? I am a South Indian. And I have a South Indian accent. And she’s so cool about it,” she shared, adding, “And then she says, I have a desire to be a Karan Johar star and then she laughs and says, but you know what? I’ll allow him to use a dubbing artist. And she was so cool about it. And I’m really in love with that.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Madhoo Shah (@madhoo_rockstar)

Notably, Madhoo also shared that, years ago, when she acted in Hindi films, she felt judged. But it also meant that she worked hard to mask it. “I was so afraid of the South Indian judgments that I was getting, and I thought I would get. And I’d learnt harder and harder. I tried to get a Urdu teacher, and I bettered myself in Hindi. Anything and everything, so that I don’t get caught out in an accent. If anybody even spotted a little bit of an accent in my tone, I would get all flustered, and I would work harder at it. And I felt very proud when people would say that your Hindi is even better than a Hindi-wala.”

As per the latest buzz, She shared that while that’s what her journey was like, she’s proud to say she’s a South Indian today. “And if I do make a mistake in the Hindi language, and if my accent does have that thickness of a South Indian, I’m okay with it. But it took me all of 30 years, 35 years to come here. And Rashmika, great power to you, girl. I just loved it. That you own it, you laugh about it, and you are really a star,” shared Madhoo.

In further updates, Criticism has followed Rashmika since the beginning of her career in Bollywood, particularly over her Kodava Takk accent coming through while speaking Hindi. When asked about it on KWK, she shared, “Ever since I started working in the movie industry, you know, I've been criticised or trolled for one thing or the other, like either my performance, or the language, or the acting, or just the accent, or anything. So for me, I never wanted to sort of put a barrier for myself. I didn't want to just work in one industry. I wanted to work in them all. I didn't want to speak just one language. I wanted to speak all languages.”
On top of that, Madhoo most of late starred in the Malayalam movie Chinna Chinna Aasai and the Hindi movie Governor. Rashmika last starred in Ranabaali in Telugu and Cocktail 2 in Hindi.

title: Daler Mehndi controversy ends as Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal apologises; Mika Singh’s team reacts
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The dispute erupted after the minister interrupted Daler Mehndi’s performance at a religious fair in Uttarakhand.

Adding to this, Reacting to the development, Mika Singh’s team rolled out an official statement expressing hope that the matter could now be put behind them. The statement read, "We appreciate that Subodh Uniyal ji has apologised to Daler Mehndi paaji over a telephonic conversation regarding the unfortunate incident. Respecting artists and their dignity is extremely important. Daler paaji is a senior artist who has contributed immensely to the music industry, and every artist deserves to be treated with respect. We hope this matter can now be put behind us and everyone can move forward with mutual respect and understanding."

Meanwhile, The dispute originated at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri, Uttarakhand, where Daler Mehndi had been invited to perform. During the event, Uniyal interrupted the singer from the stage and questioned his conduct in front of the audience. The minister alleged that Mehndi was intoxicated, was not performing properly and was lip-syncing at a religious event being held during Navratri.

Notably, The incident subsequently triggered considerable criticism from members of the entertainment industry, with several artists expressing concern over the public treatment of a senior musician. The episode also sparked a wider conversation about the respect and dignity that performers deserve, irrespective of the circumstances surrounding a live performance.

As per the latest buzz, As the disagreement escalated, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami intervened in an effort to ease tensions between the parties. Before Uniyal's direct apology to Mehndi, Mika Singh had spoken about his interaction with the Chief Minister, appreciating the latter's approach to the situation.

In further updates, Mika described Dhami as a humble and approachable leader who had communicated with him warmly and respectfully. According to the singer, the Chief Minister had also expressed regret over the incident on behalf of the cabinet minister.

On top of that, While acknowledging Dhami's gesture, Mika clarified that he did not hold the Chief Minister responsible for what had transpired. He had as per reports told Dhami that there was no need for him to apologise, as he had not personally been involved in the incident. However, Mika maintained that the minister who had interrupted the performance needed to address the matter directly with Daler Mehndi.
Mika also opened up that Dhami had invited both brothers to visit Uttarakhand and perform in the state again, signalling his willingness to help restore the relationship with the music fraternity.

The movie is also Sharvari’s return to the banner after the failure of the spy thriller Alpha. The Shiv Rawail movie also starred Alia Bhatt and Bobby Deol, and was a part of the YRF Spy Universe. However, it tanked at the ticket-window amid negative reviews. Sharvari did taste some success in 2026, however, with the success of Imtiaz Ali’s Main Vaapas Aaunga. The Partition-based drama, also starring Naseeruddin Shah, Vedang Raina, and Diljit Dosanjh, collected close to ₹ 100 crore rupees worldwide.

On top of that, Ahaan has signed two films with YRF, the makers of Saiyaara. Beparwah is the first of those titles. The star will then reunite with Aneet and Mohit Suri for a yet-untitled romantic drama.
Sharvari, meanwhile, is awaiting the rollout of Sooraj Barjatya's romantic family drama Ye Prem Mol Liya opposite Ayushmann Khurrana. The movie hits the screens on November 27.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Pop star Nick Jonas of late shared a sweet glimpse of his life with wife and star Priyanka Chopra . From performing at back-to-back concerts to spending quality time with Priyanka and their daughter, Malti Marie , Nick’s latest Instagram post offered a glimpse into his life on and off stage.

Adding to this, Nick Jonas shared glimpse of his life with Priyanka Chopra and Malti Marie. Nick Jonas shares glimpse of life with Priyanka and Malti Marie Some photos from the carousel showed Nick performing with his brothers and bandmates, Joe Jonas and Kevin Jonas. Other pictures captured him enjoying a quiet morning with coffee. One photo showed Priyanka and Nick getting cosy, while the cutest picture featured Nick picking up his daughter, Malti, capturing a sweet father-daughter moment. The post also included glimpses of Nick’s life behind the scenes, including a skincare session with a face mask. He captioned the post simply, “I am on one.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nick Jonas (@nickjonas)

Notably, Nick of late appeared on a podcast with his mother-in-law and Priyanka’s mother, Madhu Chopra. During their conversation, he discussed the factors that led to the Jonas Brothers’ breakup in 2013, before their eventual reunion in 2019.

As per the latest buzz, “There was a fraying that was happening. From our last album till the time we broke up, it was a combination of growing up, being in a pressure cooker of having reached this level of success and having not quite reached that success for a number of years, finding that we weren't extending our collaborators because we were afraid that maybe if we reached out, people wouldn't want to work with us,” he shared.

In further updates, He also spoke about his biggest flaw and his tendency to overthink certain aspects of the creative process. “My major flaw is my tendency to overthink certain things in the creative process and I always describe it as I am tightening the screw until eventually the wood breaks and you reach a sweet spot where you are giving as much effort as you can but you can also overcook it. So, just find that perfect balance where you have done your best that you feel you can do and leave it in the hands of others,” he shared.

On top of that, Nick Jonas and Priyanka Chopra first met at the Vanity Fair Oscars party in February 2017 and they started dating by May 2018. The couple got engaged in July 2018 and tied the knot in December that year in lavish ceremonies in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, celebrating both Christian and Hindu wedding traditions. In January 2022, they revealed the birth of their daughter, Malti Marie, via surrogacy.

title: Ramayana advance booking crosses ₹20 crore 10 days before release; Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's film sees houseful shows in Telugu
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Advance bookings for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana Part One are going steady after a smash hit start on Dussehra. The pre-sales for the ambitious adaptation began 15 days before its scheduled rollout, ahead of Diwali. The first day a bumper response for the tickets. The pace his since plateaued, but the momentum remains positive for the big-budget spectacle.

Adding to this, Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana has got off to a promising start in advance bookings. How Ramayana pre-sales are faring Ramayana has reached the ₹ 10 crore rupees mark in advance bookings in India alone, selling over 2 lakh tickets for its opening day domestically. Initially, the Hindi version was accounting for almost all of the pre-sales collections, but over the last two days, more Kannada and Telugu shows have begun to open. The Hindi version still accounts for 87% of the movie’s advance bookings. The Kannada version, which is now open in around 100 screens, has crossed the ₹ 1 crore rupees mark, with some centres already reporting up to 80% occupancy for the morning shows. The Telugu shows have opened in only around 10-15 screens, but are still hurtling towards the ₹ 40 lakh mark.

Meanwhile, What has helped Ramayana’s case is the pre-sales buzz overseas. In North America, the movie will have paid previews on November 4, the eve of its rollout. According to Sacnilk, the movie has sold $550K in tickets for those paid previews. In addition, Ramayana has grossed $400K for the rollout day from overseas territories. This brings the movie’s worldwide advance-booking gross to ₹ 20 crore rupees by the end of October 25, ten days before its rollout.

Notably, Only a few regional Ramayana shows have opened for advance bookings so far. The Hindi version is already selling tickets for over 4200 shows across India for day 1. In comparison, the Kannada and Telugu versions have just over 400 shows combined. Yet, the Telugu version is seeing breakneck bookings. According to Sacnilk, four of the 44 Telugu shows are already houseful. On-the-ground tracking indicates that the number across languages may exceed a dozen after accounting for blocked seats.

As per the latest buzz, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

In further updates, Sony Pictures will handle global distribution, excluding India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the movie in the Hindi-speaking market. The movie is also planned for a worldwide IMAX rollout.

title: Jamia students reject university’s appeal to end protest, say order on students’ union restoration is ‘ambiguous’
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Students of Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) on Monday rejected an appeal by the university to call off the protests, saying the notice issued to them failed to provide a clear and unambiguous announcement regarding the restoration of the students’ union, leaving several key concerns unaddressed. They reiterated that their agitation would continue.

Adding to this, Students of Jamia Millia Islamia protesting outside university gate on Sunday. ((Arvind Yadav/Hindustan Times)) The rejection comes after Jamia Millia Islamia Registrar Mahatab Alam Rizvi arrived at the University around 4:30am to engage in a dialogue with protesting students amid the ongoing agitation demanding the restoration of the students’ union .

Meanwhile, The Registrar arrived with an official notice and shared the order with the students, urging them to call off their protest, claiming that their demands had been met, students shared. However, the notice failed to provide a clear and unambiguous announcement regarding the restoration of the students’ union, leaving several key concerns unaddressed.
Notably, In the order issued on Monday, the university administration shared the elections would be held within 15 days of the approval of the students’ union constitution.

As per the latest buzz, “The Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union Election will be held after 15 days, from the date of approval of the constitution of the Students’ Union of Jamia Millia Islamia,” the order shared, news agency ANI reported.
In further updates, HT could not independently verify the contents of the order.

On top of that, The students expressed dissatisfaction with what they described as an unclear and inadequate order, arguing that it did not specify a timeline for the approval of the students’ union constitution or the conduct of elections. The notice also made no mention of the resignation of the Proctor, another demand raised by the protesting students.

Rejecting the administration’s attempt to call off the agitation on the basis of the notice, the students maintained that assurances without concrete decisions and a clear roadmap could not be treated as fulfilment of their demands.

title: LIVE: Amid EC row, BJP calls nationwide protests over Kharge’s remark on PM Modi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

BJP to hold nationwide protests, Congress faces backlash after Mallikarjun Kharge's remarks LIVE: With the INDIA bloc preparing for a major rally in Delhi on November 1 against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has revealed nationwide protests on Monday against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's remarks on Prime Minister Narendra Modi. ...Read More

Adding to this, The BJP's announcement comes amid an escalating political confrontation over the SIR exercise, with Opposition parties demanding the CEC's resignation and preparing to intensify their protests in the national capital. Meanwhile, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), which has been at the forefront of protests against the poll panel, has also indicated that it will soon announce its next course of action. What did Mallikarjun Kharge say? The latest political row between the Congress and the BJP erupted on Sunday after Kharge made the remark "Modi ka baap bhi jayega" during an event in Bihar's Patna to mark the 139th birth anniversary of the state's first chief minister, Shrikrishna Singh. The Congress chief was addressing the gathering when he shared that those involved in alleged irregularities during the SIR exercise would be sent to jail if his party came to power. At this point, a person in the audience interrupted him, saying, "As long as there is no rebellion, (Prime Minister Narendra) Modi won't go anywhere." Responding to the remark, Kharge shared, "Modi ka baap bhi jayega" (Let alone Modi, even his father would go). The audience member later identified himself as Santhosh Kumar, a Congress worker from Chhapra. In conversation with reporters, he claimed that he had been mistaken for a BJP worker because of his intervention. "What I meant was that as long as there is no rebellion in the country, Narendra Modi won't go anywhere," he clarified. Kharge's remarks drew sharp criticism from leaders of the BJP, Janata Dal (United), Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) and Hindustani Awam Morcha (HAM), who accused the Congress president of using language "associated with thugs and hooligans". The BJP subsequently opened up that it would hold protests across the country on Monday to condemn his remarks. INDIA bloc plans 'public impeachment' of CEC on October 30 Even as the row over Kharge's remarks grows, the INDIA bloc is preparing for two major events in Delhi as part of its campaign against alleged "vote theft" and irregularities in the SIR exercise. Opposition leaders will first hold a symbolic "public impeachment" of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on October 30, followed by a 'Dilli Chalo March' to Ramlila Maidan on November 1, reported news agency PTI. The Congress leadership has also stepped up preparations for the rally, holding meetings with heads of its frontal organisations and Delhi unit leaders on Sunday. Similar discussions were held with party leaders from Uttar Pradesh and Haryana a day earlier. The party is mobilising its workers to ensure a large turnout at Ramlila Maidan, saying the rally will demonstrate Opposition unity in protecting democracy and "driving vote chors out of power." CJP leaders signal fresh protests Meanwhile, the Cockroach Janta Party, whose protests against the CEC have led to repeated confrontations with Delhi Police, has indicated that another round of demonstrations could be revealed soon. CJP co-conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das, who were rolled out from custody last week, told reporters that the movement would make a “collective call for protest soon”. The two leaders also maintained that Gyanesh Kumar's resignation was inevitable, signalling that the movement would continue pressing its demand for the CEC to step down. Separately, All India Students' Association (AISA) president Neha Bora last week shared the student organisation would not sign a peace bond, describing the evidence cited against its members as “factually incorrect.” Her remarks came a day after the Delhi High Court dismissed a petition challenging a police notice directing them to execute a ₹ 10,000 personal bond with surety to maintain peace. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke was also issued a similar bond.
Meanwhile, "The people of Bihar are proud of their culture and values," Tiwari shared, adding that making derogatory remarks about the Prime Minister's late father was “unacceptable,” reported ANI.

Notably, Tiwari also targeted Rahul Gandhi, alleging that he was "acting at the behest of foreign powers" and accusing the Congress leadership of attempting to create unrest to bring down the government.

As per the latest buzz, Referring to the ongoing protests in Delhi, Tiwari claimed that disruptions had made life difficult for shopkeepers and residents. He also criticised Gandhi's political approach, saying, “Rahul Gandhi seems unaware that a government is formed through votes. He should try winning people’s hearts instead...”

In further updates, Kharge remarks row live updates: Madhya Pradesh BJP president Hemant Khandelwal has criticised Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge's remarks referring to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father, calling them derogatory and a "violation of political decorum".

On top of that, In a statement on Sunday night, Khandelwal alleged that Kharge had made such "indecent" remarks in the past and questioned whether he was acting on his own or “at the behest of the Gandhi family,” reported PTI.
"It is unfortunate that a leader in Indian democracy has made such a derogatory statement," he shared, adding that the remarks were being condemned across the country.

title: Ranbir Kapoor says playing Lord Ram in Ramayana gave him a chance to become a better human
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The cast of Ramayana — Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey — appeared on Kaun Banega Crorepati to promote their soon-to-release movie. On the show, Amitabh Bachchan asked the actors about their first instinct when they were approached to play Lord Ram, Sita Maa and Lakshman, respectively. Ranbir admitted that his first instinct was fear, but it soon turned into gratitude.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor spoke about his reaction when he was first approached to play Lord ram in Ramayana. ‘My first instinct was fear’ The makers of Kaun Banega Crorepati have rolled out a new promotional clip from the episode. Speaking about his role, Ranbir shared, "When this role was offered to me, I knew that this isn't just a role, it is a big responsibility. My first instinct was fear, that if I am qualified enough to play this role? Whether I will be able to do this role? The faith of crores of people is linked to Lord Shri Ram. But very soon this fear turned into gratitude."

Meanwhile, Ranbir admitted that the role came to him around the time he became a father, making the opportunity feel even more special. He added, "I felt gratitude that I got this opportunity at this stage in my life and a chance to become a better human. It was during this time that I became a father and I believe that this movie is a God's gift that I got an opportunity to become a better human, to understand Ramayana deeply and to get the opportunity to work with these beautiful people. It not impossible to become like Lord Ram but to learn something from him is a big deal for all of us."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by sonytvofficial (@sonytvofficial)

As per the latest buzz, During the show, Sai Pallavi also shared her approach to playing Sita Maa. She opened up that she prayed to Sita Maa before performing the role in the movie. She shared, "I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think what can I give to that character, but this was the first time when I thought - 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think anything about it. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it."

In further updates, Apart fom Ranbir, Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey, it also stars Yash plays Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Rajul Preet Singh as Surpanakha and others. It is two-part adaptation of the Hindu epic, with the first part scheduled to rollout in theatres on November 5, 2026. The movie also features music by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman.

title: Anushka Sharma claps and sings along, while Virat Kohli immerses himself in devotional tunes at Krishna Das’ Mumbai concert
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma soaked in devotional music as American musician and vocalist Krishna Das performed live kirtan in Mumbai on Sunday. The couple were spotted attending Krishna Das’ kirtan evening and appeared fully immersed in the devotional tunes. Several videos and photos of the couple at the kirtan have been doing the rounds on social media.

Adding to this, Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma attended Krishna Das’ Mumbai concert. Virat-Anushka at Krishna Das’ kirtan In one of the videos, Anushka is seen clapping and singing along to the devotional chants, fully immersed in the spiritual evening. Virat, on the other hand, briefly glances at the camera before turning his attention back to the kirtan and joining in the devotional singing. The concert was part of Krishna Das’ India tour. Other videos show Virat and Anushka arriving at the Gateway of India before heading to the devotional evening.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Team Innovation (@team.innovation)

Notably, This is not the first time Anushka and Virat have attended a Krishna Das kirtan. The couple also attended a service at Union Chapel in London in July 2026 and have often been spotted at similar spiritual events in India and abroad. Virat and Anushka are known for their reverence for the teachings associated with Neem Karoli Baba. They also regularly visit spiritual leader Premanand Maharaj in Vrindavan.

As per the latest buzz, Neem Karoli Baba was of late in the news after Hanuman Ansh, a movie based on his life, as per reports achieved significant box-office success. The movie, which was made on a budget of approximately ₹ 1.5 crore rupees to ₹ 2 crore rupees, crossed ₹ 450 crore rupees worldwide.

In further updates, Krishna Das travelled to India in 1970 and became a close disciple and devotee of Neem Karoli Baba. He spent several years in India, primarily at Neem Karoli Baba’s ashrams, including Kainchi Dham in the mountains of Uttarakhand. Two of Krishna Das’ devotional chants, “Sita Ram” and “Om Namah Shivaya,” were also used in Hanuman Ansh.

On top of that, Anushka and Virat have largely remained away from the public eye in recent years. The couple spend much of their time in London, UK, where they are raising their two children, Vamika Kohli and Akaay Kohli. They are currently in Mumbai as the cricketer prepares for India’s soon-to-release ODI series against New Zealand.

Meanwhile, Anushka has stayed away from the big screen. She was last seen in Shah Rukh Khan’s 2018 movie Zero and later appeared in a cameo role in Qala. The star has largely kept a low profile while focusing on her family and other commitments.

title: AR Rahman is amused by people criticising Ramayana songs, then apologising; reveals he once let go of Hans Zimmer collab to 'chill' | HT Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Many felt it was a match made in heaven when AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer were brought on board as the composers for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana . The first piece of music, revealed in the title announcement, was lauded. The songs have evoked mixed reactions, with many first criticising and then praising them. In an exclusive chat with Hindustan Times, Rahman opens up on composing the music for Rahman, why he broke his ‘no collab’ rule for Hans Zimmer, and his reaction to the public reactions.

Adding to this, AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer have composed the score for Ramayana. Ramayana came to Rahman three decades into his career, and the composer knew he had to do something different for a story of this epic proportions. He explains, “After the first 10 years, people shared, 'Oh, you should do what you did in those first 10 years.' But I can't stay on old glory like Rockstar or Slumdog Millionaire . You can't stagnate yourself—you have to be like a flowing river. Now Ramayana has come, and these songs are in five different languages. It's an epic story almost every Indian knows. It is a movie, an epic, a story almost every Indian knows. It's such a great honour to do those songs and be part of that celebration with India and the world. It's a huge honour and a big responsibility.”

Meanwhile, Rahman has always composed music solo, opting for no collaborators. But with Ramayana, that changed. The two-time Oscar winner is working with Hans Zimmer, arguably one of the most celebrated and acclaimed composers of all time. Talking about the collaboration, he says, “Usually I prefer solo work because I'm bad at being precious about my work. I'd just say, 'You do everything and I'll watch!' But in this case, him coming onto the project is such a blessing because it changes the narrative. If someone in New Zealand or Europe sees Hans Zimmer's name, they will watch. If they just see Indian names, they might think it's just another Indian movie, but they'll be curious to see what he has done collaborating on this. It's a great move by the producer.”

Notably, Rahman reveals that he had an opportunity to collaborate with Zimmer right after Slumdog Millionaire, but he let it pass. “He had actually invited me to work together 14–15 years ago, right after the Oscar (he won for Slumdog), but back then I was in chill-out mode,” the composer says with a laugh.

As per the latest buzz, Three songs from Ramayana have been rolled out so far. The loudest chatter was around the Ravana Tandav, which first received criticism, but later had social media users apologising to Rahman. The composer says he had no energy to check the reactions but was aware of the discourse. “We do so much work, filtration, ideation, and iteration that there's no energy left to look at feedback! We just put it out because it's been tried and tested so much. My son keeps telling me, 'This is what they shared yesterday, now they're apologising...' I say fine, I've done my work sincerely and hope people celebrate it.”

In further updates, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana and directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part movie starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, and Sai Pallavi as Sita. Part One releases worldwide on November 5, ahead of Diwali. The second part is slated for rollout around Diwali 2027. Rahman, meanwhile, will perform at Jio World Garden, Mumbai on November 1 and Backyard Sports Club, Delhi on November 21, as part of his Wonderment Tour. The three hour musical experience brings together some of his most iconic 90s compositions alongside his contemporary work, with a large scale live production and international ensemble.

On top of that, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). With a good understanding of cinema and its trends, and a keen eye for detail, he continues to spark conversations around showbiz for readers around the world. Read More

title: Kriti Sanon was tired of playing good girl roles early in her career, says it is refreshing to see more realistic parts for women being written
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kriti Sanon has come a long way since making her Hindi movie debut with Heropanti. From winning a National Award for Best Star to opening her own production house, the star has tried to experiment with her career and take chances. In an episode of What Women Want with host Kareena Kapoor, the star has now opened up about the kind of roles she wants to do after doing 20 films in her career.

Adding to this, Kriti Sanon was last seen in Cocktail 2. (Photo by Sujit JAISWAL / AFP) (AFP) What Kriti shared When Kareena asked her about the kind of role she wants to try that keeps her out of the comfort zone. To this, Kriti shared that when she was new to the industry she was aware of choosing the best out of the few things that was offered to her in terms of characters. She shared, “You don't have all amazing opportunities instantly. For a very long time, it was like the good girl. For a long time, the woman is seen from the male gaze. Which is ‘sati savitri’ (good girl), coy, shy, one who has to be saved from the hooligans… never does the wrong thing.”

Meanwhile, “It is refreshing that people are now writing parts that are more real, more human, not necessarily white, human enough to make mistakes and does things that may not be morally right… and I was bored of doing the good girl parts. In life, in general I have the good girl syndrome…” she added.

Notably, The star then went on to share the experience of doing double roles in Do Patti, and how playing a complex character who is mean and selfish really felt like a change. Kriti then gave example of Joaquin Phoenix's performance in Joker and how the audience stills roots for that character and sees the pain.

As per the latest buzz, Over her 12-year-long career, Kriti has proved her mettle time and again. She won the National Award for her performance in Mimi and has starred in successful projects such as Bareilly Ki Barfi, Dilwale, Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya, Crew, and more. She collected praise for her performance in Homi Adajania's Cocktail 2.

title: Rana Daggubati recalls Ranbir Kapoor, Ayan Mukerji ‘kidnapping’ him for Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani cameo while he was shooting another film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rana Daggubati made a brief cameo in Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone -starrer Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, which was rolled out in 2013. Of late, while speaking at IFP 2026 (India Movie Project) at Mehboob Studios in Mumbai, Rana recalled how Ranbir and the movie’s director, Ayan Mukerji, unexpectedly roped him in for the cameo.

Adding to this, Rana Daggubati spoke about his cameo in Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone's Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani. ‘They just kidnapped me’ Recalling the incident, Rana shared that another big star was initially supposed to play the role but declined the offer. Ayan and Ranbir then approached him. The duo persuaded him to travel with them to Udaipur for the cameo while he was shooting for another project.

Meanwhile, He shared, "I am friends with Ranbir and Ayan. Some big star was supposed to play that, and that star shared no. So these guys came to my hotel room where I was staying and shooting for some other movie. They just kidnapped me and shared you have to come to Udaipur tonight with us. They took me on the flight and shot that scene with me and came back."

Notably, Rana also spoke about how he approaches cameo roles, saying he does not think of them in the same way as full-fledged parts. He added, “That’s as much as I can remember about cameos. So, I vaguely remember something happened in the night. I shot something and I was back in the morning to another set. So I was like, something has happened. That's as much as I remember about the cameo."

As per the latest buzz, In Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, Rana played Vikram Jaiswal, a photographer who is shooting at Aditi’s (Kalki Koechlin) wedding. Aditi is a close friend of Naina (Deepika Padukone) and Bunny (Ranbir Kapoor). During the cameo, Vikram tries to flirt with Naina, prompting Bunny to step in and pull him away. The interaction leads to a confrontation between the two men.

In further updates, Directed by Ayan Mukerji and produced by Karan Johar and Hiroo Yash Johar under the banner of Dharma Productions, Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani was rolled out in theatres in , 2013. The romantic comedy followed four friends whose lives and relationships evolve as they reunite at different stages of their lives. The movie became a major box-office success and remains popular among the audience,especially for its music.

title: FIR filed against 2 Congress MPs for 'trespass' as Jamia university protest over student union demand continues
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

An FIR has as per reports been filed against Congress MPs Imran Masood and Imran Pratapgarhi for ‘trespassing’ on the campus of Delhi's Jamia Millia Islamia university. The FIR was filed on a complaint by the university, which accused them of trespassing on the campus and inciting unrest amid the ongoing protest over students' union demand, news agency PTI reported.

Adding to this, Heavy security is deployed as students of Jamia Millia Islamia stage a protest demanding entry to the campus amid an ongoing strike on Sunday. (Arvind Yadav/HT) The protest, which includes a hunger strike, began on October 12, with students continuing to press their demands. The students have as per reports accused the university administration of cracking down on the protesters.
Meanwhile, The entry from gate number 7 and nearby gates to the protest site was completely banned on Sunday while the police made announcements for students to vacate the premises and the footpaths.
Notably, The FIR was filed against Congress MPs on a complaint by JMI, accusing them of trespassing on the campus.
As per the latest buzz, The university authorities had lodged a formal complaint with the police against Congress Lok Sabha MP Masood, Rajya Sabha MP Imran Pratapgarhi and others.
In further updates, Subsequently, Delhi Police registered an FIR for alleged trespassing against the MPs, PTI reported.
On top of that, The university administration revealed on Saturday that all courses would move to online format with immediate effect until further notice.
The protesting students also questioned the administration's decision to shift all classes online and shut down core facilities, news agency ANI reported.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 3: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan film crosses ₹19 crore in opening weekend
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Udta Teer ticket-window earnings day 3 : Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan 's quirky take on the genre of a spy movie, Udta Teer, was rolled out in theatres this Friday. Amid ticket-window releases like Nayyi Navelli and Prahaar from last week, the movie has managed to put up a steady run in its opening weekend. After a decent rollout day haul, the movie has shown a surprising amount of growth in the next two days. Let's take a closer look.

Adding to this, Udta Teer ticket-window earnings day 3: Ayushmann Khurrana plays a Pakistani spy in Udta Teer. Udta Teer ticket-window Udta Teer leveled up above expectations and collected ₹ 4.10 crore rupees on its opening day in theatres. It opened to decent reviews, which helped its cause and the movie gradually showed growth on Saturday to collect ₹ 7.25 crore rupees. As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Udta Teer has grown further on Sunday, and managed to collect ₹ 8.10 crore rupees. This brings the total collection of the movie to a solid ₹ 19.45 crore rupees after three days of rollout.

Meanwhile, Taran Adarsh commented on the movie's ticket-window pull and wrote on X, "springs a wonderful surprise, witnessing a solid 76.83% jump on Saturday... The major multiplexes across urban centres have been recording strong occupancies, and the trend is expected to continue on Sunday.

Notably, While the national chains doubled their business on Saturday, several centres also witnessed a significant jump, beyond #Mumbai... #Bengaluru, #Kolkata, #Jaipur, #Hyderabad, #Pune, and #Chennai reported solid footfalls.
As per the latest buzz, The movie now needs to sustain this momentum through the weekdays to post a respectable Week 1 total."

In further updates, Udta Teer marks the directorial debut of Akash A Kaushik, who earlier worked as a writer on movies such as Housefull 4, Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2 and Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3. The movie follows a Pakistani spy, played by Khurrana, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

title: Centre dispatches 250 RAF personnel to Arunachal Pradesh as Siang hydropower project protest turns violent
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

After violence erupted during protests over the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, the Centre on Saturday as per reports dispatched two Rapid Action Force (RAF) companies of the CRPF to Arunachal Pradesh's Pasighat.

Adding to this, A view of the structural debris after a protest against the proposed large-scale dam on the Siang River turned violent in Pasighat, in East Siang on Saturday. (ANI Video Grab ) The ministry of home affairs (MHA) directed on Saturday that the RAF companies comprising about 250 personnel will be airlifted from Navi Mumbai on board an IAF transport aircraft. The units will reach Pasighat and get deployed by Sunday, officials shared, news agency PTI reported. RAF is a special blue-uniform donning anti-riot unit of the Central Reserved Police Force (CRPF)

Meanwhile, The northeastern state of Arunachal Pradesh has a permanent deployment of about nearly three CRPF battalions, while multiple units have additionally been deployed in the violence-affected areas.

Notably, Violence erupted in Arunachal Pradesh on Friday amid protests over the proposed Siang project . A mob as per reports torched the National Hydroelectric Power Corporation (NHPC) office and a police station. Houses of three political leaders, including that of the state BJP chief, in East Siang district were also targeted on Friday night, according to Arunachal Pradesh Police officials.

As per the latest buzz, Chief minister Pema Khandu shared the right to peaceful protest was an essential part of democracy, but it was important that demonstrations remained within the bounds of the law and did not result in damage to property or disruption of public order.
In further updates, He shared the incidents in Pasighat were regrettable and called upon all sections of society to maintain peace.

On top of that, According to a statement issued by the Chief Minister's Office (CMO), Khandu shared a 12-hour bandh in Siang, Upper Siang and East Siang districts over the power project remained largely peaceful on Friday. But violence erupted in Pasighat after the bandh ended and continued till 3.30 am on Saturday.

While the locals are protesting against the hydropower project, the state government sees the project as a strategic safeguard against China’s massive hydropower development upstream. However, those dwelling along the banks of the river fear displacement, ecological destruction and the loss of ancestral land.

title: Amitabh Bachchan greets fans outside Jalsa amid heavy security for bomb threat probe, days after sparking concern about his health
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran star Amitabh Bachchan has been interacting with followers outside his residence in Mumbai, Jalsa, every Sunday. This is a tradition he has been continuing for years. This Sunday too, Amitabh made it a point to briefly come out of his house and greet hundreds of followers. The interaction comes after the star allegedly recieved bomb threat email of late.

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan greets followers at his residence Jalsa, in Mumbai, Sunday,(PTI Photo/Kunal Patil)(PTI10_18_2026_000447A) (PTI) Amitabh greets followers outside Jalsa The office of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) Mayor Ritu Tawde on Friday received a bomb threat email, with the message also threatening Bollywood star Amitabh Bachchan, singer-star Diljit Dosanjh and several city-based schools.

Meanwhile, Amitabh waved to the crowd in his signature style and expressed gratitude for their love and affection. He was joined by his son and star Abhishek Bachchan. The followers were stationed outside the residence, while Mumbai Police personnel stood near Amitabh Bachchan to ensure his security. Abhishek Bachchan also stood behind the veteran star, keeping a watchful eye on the crowd.

Notably, A bomb threat email allegedly targeting veteran star Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow in Mumbai was reported to Mumbai Police on Friday. The threatening email was received by a school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area. Mumbai Police have launched an investigation into the matter.

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Amitabh Bachchan raised quite a few eyebrows on Wednesday as he put up a post on his blog about his health condition. He shared that he will take a break from his usual social media updates after being advised to rest and recover. On Friday, Amitabh shared another health update on his Tumblr account. He shared, “Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering ..the human body and its uniqueness.”

In further updates, Earlier, he made a post on X in which he revealed the doctor's advice and wrote in Hindi, "Apologies. I seek forgiveness. I have been advised to take a few days off to rest and recover, so I am unable to write anything at the moment." While extending his Dussehra wishes, the star shared he had been given strict instructions to focus on his recovery and avoid communication for the time being.

On top of that, "First Dussehra greetings to all .. love happiness, fulfilment, prayers. Under very strict rest and recuperation .. so am not allowed to communicate .. do excuse .. my apologies," he wrote. He also added, “But do take this as my respected response .. more hopefully later.”

Amitabh Bachchan is currently hosting the quiz reality show Kaun Banega Crorepati. On the cinema front, the star was last seen in the Tamil movie Vettaiyan, which starred Rajinikanth in the lead role.

title: Tiger Shroff's team denies any statement about actor expressing shock over assassination attempt in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On October 18, three assailants publicly fired guns at Tiger Shroff in the Juhu area in Mumbai. The star did not sustain any bullet wounds, while his driver and a bystander did. Ten persons have been apprehended in the case so far from Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana.

Adding to this, Tiger Shroff escaped relatively unhurt, while his driver and a bystander were injured after unidentified assailants attacked the star's vehicle on Oct. 18, in Mumbai. (DCM PRO) Tiger Shroff's spokesperson clarifies An NDTV report cited sources saying that Tiger gave a statement expressing shock to Mumbai Police's Crime Branch.
Meanwhile, "I am in deep shock. I do not wish to say anything right now. Who would want to carry out such a life-threatening attack on me, and why," he was reported to have shared.
Notably, However, when contacted, Tiger Shroff’s spokesperson refuted the report and shared, “This news is completely untrue. Tiger has not made any such statement. No such thing has happened.”

As per the latest buzz, In his first pictures after the incident, Tiger was seen wearing bandages on his arm and shoulder, which worried his followers. His team posted a video showing burn marks on his skin, which seemed to explain the bandages. The official Team Tiger Shroff page posted a short video to explain the marks on his body. Tiger’s team also put out a statement after the firing attack, warning against the circulation of misinformation and AI videos. “We would like to categorically clarify that Tiger Shroff has made no statements, rolled out no videos, and authorised no communication regarding the recent incident or any related developments,” read a portion of their statement.

In further updates, They also wrote, “It has come to our attention that several social media pages and digital platforms are circulating fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger. These are completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.” The team warned of legal consequences for those continuing to spread misinformation.

On top of that, Meanwhile, PTI reported that a 22-year-old man was arrested in Indore on Saturday in connection with the shooting incident involving Bollywood star Tiger Shroff, while Mumbai police recovered two firearms from Surat that were allegedly used to target the star's car, officials shared.

Arrests in Tiger’s case were made within hours of the incident, with three suspects being picked up in Kota and brought to Mumbai. Gangster Anil Pandit, a close aide of Lawrence Bishnoi, claimed responsibility for the firing in a social media post. Four suspects in the case have been identified as Kunal (21) and Sumit (19), both residents of Haryana's Sonipat district, and Radha (23) and Babita (23), both from Uttar Pradesh.

title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai’s Khar apartment for Rs 9 crores
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The apartment is located on the ninth floor of Rustomjee Paramount D Co-operative Housing Society in Khar West. According to the documents, the property has a carpet area of 1,291.14 square feet, along with an exclusive area of 95.80 square feet. The deal was registered at an approximate rate of Rs 64,891 per square foot. The transaction also involved a stamp duty payment of Rs 54 lakhs and included two covered car parking spaces.

Adding to this, Shroff had purchased the apartment from developer Keystone Realtors Private Limited on July 17, 2018, for Rs 7.61 crores. He took possession of the property on November 30, 2019, the documents shared. The star could not be reached for comment on the sale.

Meanwhile, This is not the first time Shroff has sold a property in the same residential project. A year earlier, the star sold another apartment at Rustomjee Paramount for Rs 15.6 crores, according to documents reviewed by Square Yards. The sale as per reports collected him a gain of nearly 31%.

Notably, The earlier apartment was located on the 22nd floor and had a carpet area of 1,989.72 square feet and a built-up area of 2,189 square feet. Shroff had purchased it in 2018 for Rs 11.62 crores before selling it in 2025 for Rs 15.6 crores. The transaction included three car parking spaces, while the buyer paid stamp duty of Rs 93.60 lakhs and registration charges of Rs 30,000.
As per the latest buzz, Rustomjee Paramount is spread across 1.65 acres and offers two-, three-, four- and five-bedroom apartments, according to Square Yards.

In further updates, Earlier in 2026, Shroff also sold a residential property in Pune’s Hadapsar for Rs 8.87 crores, as per registration documents accessed by Zapkey. He had purchased the apartment in March 2024 for Rs 7.5 crores, translating into a gross return on investment of 18.3%, according to the data platform.

On top of that, Located in the Yoo Pune building developed by Panchshil Realty, the apartment measures 4,249 square feet and was sold along with three parking spaces. The transaction, registered on March 31, 2026, was valued at approximately Rs 20,891 per square foot. Stamp duty of over Rs 62 lakhs and registration charges of Rs 30,000 were paid.
Tiger Shroff, son of veteran star Jackie Shroff, made his Bollywood debut with Heropanti in 2014. He is known for his action-oriented roles and dance performances.

title: Sai Pallavi says she ‘prayed to Sita Maa’ before playing her in Ramayana during KBC appearance with Ranbir Kapoor
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The stars of Ramayana — Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey — appeared on Amitabh Bachchan's Kaun Banega Crorepati to promote their soon-to-release movie. During the interaction, Amitabh warmly welcomed the three actors and expressed pride in the fact that they are starring in the epic. Sai Pallavi also spoke about playing Sita and how she approached the role.

Adding to this, Sai Pallavi shared her approach to play Sita Maa in Ramayana. Sai Pallavi on playing Sita During the show, Amitabh asked the actors what came to their minds when they were approached to play their respective roles. Sai Pallavi recalled her reaction, saying that she did not approach the role with calculations but instead allowed it to teach her.

Meanwhile, She shared, "I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think what can I give to that character, but this was the first time when I thought - 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think anything about it. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by sonytvofficial (@sonytvofficial)

As per the latest buzz, In another promotional clip from the show, Ranbir, Ravie and Sai make a grand entry, with dancers welcoming them amid chants of Jai Shri Ram’. Later, Ranbir asked Big B to share his one memory of celebrating Diwali as a kid. The veteran star shared one playful memory and shared, “Diwali ki ek he yaad hai, ki agar bagal vale ke yaha bomb fata hai, toh humara bomb usse zyada tez hona chahiye (I remember one thing about Diwali: if a firecracker goes off at a neighbour’s place, ours has to be even louder).”
In further updates, The Diwali special episode of Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 is scheduled to air on October 29 and 30 at 9 pm on Sony Entertainment Television and SonyLIV.

On top of that, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The ensemble cast also includes Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Arun Govil as Dasharath and Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi.
It is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations. The first instalment is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical rollout on November 5, 2026.

title: Jamia protest intensifies over student union demand; 4 students on hunger strike, heavy security outside campus
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The protest at Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) in Delhi continued on Sunday, with students demanding the restoration of the students' union and four protesters remaining on hunger strike. Around 200 students were inside the university campus as security personnel in large numbers took positions outside the premises.

Adding to this, The university administration revealed on Saturday that all classes would be conducted online with immediate effect until further notice. (PTI) Access to the protest site through Gate No. 7 and nearby gates has been restricted, with students alleging that they are not being allowed to carry food or water inside.
Meanwhile, Police personnel have also been making repeated announcements over loudspeakers, asking students to vacate the campus premises and nearby footpaths.

Notably, The agitation, which began on October 12, centres on demands for the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students' Union (JMISU) and the removal of the university's Chief Proctor. Protesters have accused the administration of taking action against students participating in the demonstration.

As per the latest buzz, The JMI Students' Union was suspended in 2006 following repeated incidents of violent clashes, attacks on teachers and occasional disruptions to classes. Students are now demanding its restoration, with the current protest and hunger strike continuing amid a standoff with the university administration.

In further updates, The university administration revealed on Saturday that all classes would be conducted online with immediate effect until further notice. The decision was accompanied by the closure of the library, canteens and main entry gates, prompting criticism from protesting students.
On top of that, Students alleged that the move was intended to clear the campus and weaken the ongoing agitation near the Ghalib statue lawns.
Student Mohammad Ayan Khan shared the administration's decision had raised concerns about students' ability to attend classes and prepare for soon-to-release examinations.
