title: Anil Kapoor gets emotional remembering Satish Kaushik after meeting his lookalike on India Ke Top 1%
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Anil Kapoor of late got emotional while remembering his close friend and late star-filmmaker Satish Kaushik . The star was reminded of Satish when he came across a contestant who resembled him on India Ke Top 1% – The Anil Kapoor Show.

Adding to this, Anil Kapoor got emotional thinking about late star Satish Kaushik. (PTI) Anil Kapoor gets emotional remembering Satish Kaushik A contestant named Gagan appeared on India Ke Top 1% , and his resemblance to Satish Kaushik caught Anil’s attention. Anil admitted that Gagan reminded him of his late friend, while Gagan opened up that many people had told him he looked like the star.

Meanwhile, Speaking about his friendship with Satish, Anil shared, “My bond with him, I cannot explain. Even if this shoot were 70 minutes long, it would not be enough to tell his stories. He was a very very dear friend of mine but apart from that his talent and fun was lajawab (excellent).”

Notably, Anil also recalled affectionately calling Satish Kaushik ‘Danny DeVito’. Both actors loved the movie Twins and had often imagined playing twin brothers on screen together. However, Anil expressed regret that they never got the chance to play brothers onscreen.

As per the latest buzz, Talking about their bond, he added, “Agar mera koi judwa bhai ban sakta hai, to wo sirf Satish tha, kyunki usko mere baare mein har cheez pata thi: mera gussa, meri khushi, har cheez. He knew me so well (If I would have had a twin brother, it would have been Satish. He knew everything about me, my anger, my happiness and everything).”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Tcx.official (@tcx.official)

On top of that, Anil and Gagan later lightened the mood by singing Satish Kaushik’s famous lines, “Mera naam hai Calendra, main chala kitchen ke andar!” from Anil’s 1987 movie Mr India, in which Satish played Calendar, the cook.

Satish Kaushik worked in Hindi cinema for over four decades. He became a household name for playing Calendar in Mr India, which also starred Sridevi. He collected recognition for his performances in films such as Ram Lakhan, Saajan Chale Sasural and Deewana Mastana. Apart from acting, Kaushik directed films including Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja, Hum Aapke Dil Mein Rehte Hain and Tere Naam. He died on March 9, 2023, at the age of 66.

title: Mirzapur actor Shweta Tripathi: I have lived in different cities par hoon main Uttar Pradesh ki beti!
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Shweta Tripathi was born in New Delhi, but she considers herself a UPite as her mother hails from Lucknow and her father from Ram Madarpur village in Sandila, Hardoi. Professionally, too, she has done multiple projects here, another reason for her to fall in love with the city

Adding to this, Shweta Tripathi on her visit to Lucknow (Photo: Danish Sayed) On her recent visit to the state capital, the Mirzapur: The Movie star says, “My father was also a teacher in Lucknow before he became an IAS officer. With him, I have travelled a lot, but hoon main UP ki beti. Professionally also, Lucknow humko bula hi leta hai!”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Shweta Tripathi (@battatawada)

Notably, Her recent visit to Lucknow took her on a nostalgic journey down memory lane. “I have so many memories of Lucknow that every trip brings a lot of nostalgia. My nana used to give me ₹ 5 and it had so much value then, and a lot of love with it. I remember enjoying my favourite Goldspot soft drink and going on a food outing to Rovers along with a ride on a scooty to Hazratganj. We used to look forward to relishing chaat and kebabs, as I am a big foodie,” she says.

As per the latest buzz, Tripathi adds, “During my vacations, we witnessed extreme temperatures as if it were summer, then we had to brave loo (heat waves) and chilling cold in winters. I remember celebrating Dussehra in Lucknow, and it was not just a general outing. We used to be in festive dress for the occasion, go to the Dussehra mela ground and then have a family dinner.”

In further updates, A self-confessed fashion buff, Tripathi says she loves shopping here. “My wardrobe has so many chikankari dresses which I keep wearing very often. And I know it will keep calling me back. Kuch shehron se aapka rishta juda hota hai and I don’t know what the reasoning and explanation is! Also, my special connection is due to my co-star and colleague Ali (Fazal, star). The way he treats and hosts you with love is very special.
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Shweta Tripathi (@battatawada)

Work wise, she has done a lot of shoots here. "Professionally also Lucknow humko bula hi leta hai! I have shot different seasons of Mirzapur here, Raat Akeli Hai (2020), Kanjoos Makkhichoos (2023), and I have been brand ambassador to the UP Warriorz T20 Cricket team for Women's Premier Cricket. Besides shooting and cricket, I keep coming for promotions, panel discussions and appearances too. I am very regular here."

title: Anup Soni expresses disappointment over his deleted scenes from Parineeti Chopra-starrer Shaque, says a lot of hard work went into them
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Anup Soni , who of late played Inspector Khurana in Netflix’s mystery thriller Shaque : Trust No One, starring Parineeti Chopra and Jennifer Winget, posted on Instagram on Saturday to express his disappointment over some of his scenes being deleted from the show.

Adding to this, Anup Soni played the role of Inspector Khurana in Shaque. Anup Soni disappointed over his deleted scenes Sharing the deleted scenes on Instagram, Anup mentioned in the caption that a lot of hard work goes into creating such sequences, but they sometimes fail to make the final cut. One video shows a wounded Anup being tackled by his co-star Vicky Arora, followed by a sequence in which he strangles the star. Other clips show Anup running out of breath with a camera attached to his waist.

Meanwhile, Expressing his disappointment that these sequences did not make it to the final cut, Anup wrote in the caption, “A few sequences of Khurana Saab from SHAQUE that didn’t make it to the final version,A lot of thought, time, effort and resources go into creating these sequences, with the writers, director, action choreographers, actors, cinematographer, producer and the entire crew contributing to the process.”

Notably, He also acknowledged that this is part of the filmmaking process. He wrote, “There can be a little disappointment when a sequence doesn’t make the final cut, but filmmaking is about the larger picture, and sometimes, leaving something out serves the story better. It’s all part of the process.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by ANUP SONI (@anupsoni3)

In further updates, Shaque: Trust No One is directed by Rensil D’Silva and produced by Siddharth P Malhotra and Sapna Malhotra under Alchemy Productions. The series features Parineeti Chopra in the lead role, alongside Jennifer Winget, Soni Razdan, Anup Soni, Tahir Raj Bhasin, Sumeet Vyas, Harleen Sethi and Dhruv Choudhry in pivotal roles. The show premiered on Netflix on September 24.

On top of that, Apart from Shaque, Anup was of late seen in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, a fantasy thriller starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia. He plays Shashi Bhaiya in the movie, which was rolled out in theatres on September 25.

Anup Soni began his acting career in the 1990s. He appeared in television shows such as CID, before gaining wider recognition for playing Bhairon Singh in Balika Vadhu. He became a household name as the host of the crime documentary series Crime Patrol, which he hosted for several years. He aso appears in supporting roles in films, some of these projects include Gangaajal, Apaharan, Hathyar, Prassthanam, Satyameva Jayate 2 and more.

title: Kutle Khan’s manager blames Shilpa Rao for interrupting singer’s performance, Himesh Reshammiya for delays at BMP; alleges false PR narrative
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kutle Khan’s team has reacted to the backlash the singer faced after Shilpa Rao ’s performance was cut short at the 10th anniversary edition of the Bollywood Music Project (BMP) in Mumbai on October 24. The team has claimed that Shilpa interrupted Kutle Khan’s performance to address the audience, adding that the singer’s set had already been shortened by the organisers.

Adding to this, Kutle Khan’s manager spoke on Shilpa Rao row at Bollywood Music Project. The incident sparked outrage on social media after Shilpa was cut off while thanking the audience for their love and support. As she was speaking from one end of the stage, Kutle Khan’s performance began, and her microphone was switched off, leaving followers and attendees upset.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the incident, Kutle Khan’s manager, Sharad Sharma, told News18, “The festival team had allotted each artist 15-20 minutes onstage. But they chopped Khan saab’s performance time further. He was only given 10 minutes. But we were okay with it since they paid us. Shilpa finished her performance and left the stage. Once Khan saab began his set, she interrupted his performance and shared that she would want to thank everyone.”

Notably, “He stopped his performance for her. Thereafter, the festival organiser, Deepak Chaudhary, came to us and told Khan saab to sing Dil Pe Zakham Khate Hain. He kept telling him ki start karo, start karo. We should instead be upset about his performance being disrupted by Shilpa. She should’ve thanked everyone at the end of her own performance. She went backstage and then came back when Khan saab was halfway through his set,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, Sharad also criticised what he described as a false narrative being circulated on social media against Kutle Khan. While saying that he held no grudges against Shilpa, he alleged that her PR team was attempting to portray the incident as Kutle Khan interrupting her performance.

In further updates, Sharad maintained that the situation was the other way around, claiming that Shilpa had interrupted Kutle Khan midway through his set. He added that Kutle Khan’s team could also have taken to social media to present its side of the story but preferred not to get involved in such narratives.

On top of that, Sharad further explained that the organisers had secured permission for only one day this year, leading them to schedule all the artists together. He alleged that Himesh Reshammiya’s sound check took three hours, causing delays that affected the performance slots of other artists. According to Sharad, the delay resulted in the performance time being cut short for several artists, including both Shilpa Rao and Kutle Khan.

Meanwhile, Shilpa had taken to social media to express her disappointment over the incident, saying she was 'heartbroken' after her performance was cut short. The organisers also issued an apology, attributing the disruption to delays and curfew guidelines.

They greet the audience with folded hands before taking their seats on the hot seat. Ranbir then asks Amitabh if he has a particular memory of celebrating Diwali as a child.

Meanwhile, The veteran star shares a playful memory and says, “Diwali ki ek he yaad hai, ki agar bagal vale ke yaha bomb fata hai, toh humara bomb usse zyada tez hona chahiye (I remember one thing about Diwali: if a firecracker goes off at a neighbour’s place, ours has to be even louder).”

Notably, Earlier, the makers of Ramayana shared a behind-the-scenes video from the movie. In the clip, Ranbir talks about the challenges of playing Lord Rama on screen and says it is a huge responsibility.

As per the latest buzz, Ranbir shared, “Lord Rama's biggest strength is not his bow; it is his Kshama (forgiving nature) - his ability to forgive. Ye role nahi hai. It's not ki mujhe ek movie offer hui hai aur role exciting hai. Ye ek zimmedaari hai (This is not a role. It's not as if I was offered a movie and the role is exciting. It's a responsibility).”

In further updates, He added, “Everything comes down to the belief and simplicity of the individual playing Lord Rama. Every day I reminded myself that my job was not to be worthy of this role. My job was to be worthy of the faith that people place in this story.”

On top of that, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The project features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The movie also stars Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan and Lara Dutta.
The first instalment is scheduled for rollout on November 5, while the second part is planned for Diwali 2027.

title: Musafir Cafe author Divya Prakash Dubey: Lucknow is the core of my stories
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Author Divya Prakash Dubey is basking in the overwhelming response to the OTT adaptation of his book Musafir Cafe . During a visit to his hometown, he reflects on how the city and his experiences there have deeply shaped his storytelling.

Adding to this, Author Divya Prakash Dubey on his visit to Lucknow (Photo: Deep Saxena) “The roof of my house is the base of all my stories. It may sound philosophical, but when nothing much was happening in life, joh bechaini chhat pe tahelte hue mehsoos ki wahi mera adhaar hai! I did my schooling and my first job here. I got very emotional when someone shared a photo of a big Musafir Cafe hoarding that was visible from my home’s roof,” says Dubey.

Meanwhile, He reveals that while his books may be set in different cities, their emotional and creative roots remain firmly anchored in Lucknow. “The reassurance that mohalle ke bhaiyya offer, with a hand on your shoulder and the promise that sab ho jayega, gave me the confidence to believe that things will work out. The essence of my stories lies in Lucknow.”

Notably, He recalls how his book’s protagonist had a city connection. “In Musafir Cafe , Chander’s bechaini is what I have felt in Lucknow. I used to take an auto to Charbagh railway station and sit on a platform berth for hours and just watch people going about their life. I used to make back stories watching them. A lot of dialogues and subplots in the series have a base in Lucknow. So, for me the metaphor is: Musafir Cafe and the station is the juncture where people come, meet and go, making memories!”

As per the latest buzz, He connects with cricketer MS Dhoni catching a train in his biopic. “I still get goosebumps when I see it. Catching the bus or train at the spur of the moment is the genesis of the story and my life too – else I would have also been stuck in a 9-5 job.”

In further updates, He recalls a life-changing moment that happened at the railway platform. “A fan of Osho (Acharya Rajneesh), I picked a book and that uncle quoted ₹ 250. I asked for a discount and he replied: ‘beta, iski har line 250 rupay ki hai’ and that stirred me. It taught me a wisdom of life that no management school will tell and my perception about reading and thinking changed!”

On top of that, Coming back to the city where he used to browse books and now signing books for readers fills him with nostalgia. “I remember spending hours at Universal Booksellers when I was doing my engineering coaching at Hazratganj. Now, signing books for readers at the same place is very special. Before this I signed over 500 copies at the book festival. I remember going to roadside stalls like in Lalbagh to get gems which are out of print.”

He adds, “Since the series premiered, book sales have increased manifold, and the book is now available in English as well. People are trying to find answers in the book. As an author, the show has elevated my identity. It’s unprecedented and I am now easily getting my revised fee too (laughs).”

title: Ramayana: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film sees houseful shows 10 days before release; IMAX shows sell 400% more tickets despite ₹1095 average price
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Advance bookings for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana Part One began on Dussehra, 15 days ahead of the movie’s rollout. Five days on, the pace has picked up and the movie is steadily crossing pre-sales earnings milestones. Most importantly, many shows across the country have already started selling out, with the IMAX screenings proving to be the biggest driver of the movie’s pre-sales bumper bonanza so far.

Adding to this, Ramayana will rollout worldwide on November 5. How Ramayana pre-sales are faring Ramayana has already reached the ₹ 8.72 crore rupees mark in advance bookings, selling close to 2 lakh tickets already. Initially, the Hindi version was accounting for almost all of the pre-sales collections, but over the last two days, more Kannada and Telugu shows have begun to open. The Hindi version still accounts for 87% of the movie’s advance bookings. The Kannada version, which is now open in around 100 screens is now inching towards the ₹ 1 crore rupees mark, with some centres already reporting up to 72% occupancy for the morning shows. The Telugu shows have opened in only around 10-15 screens, barely crossing the ₹ 1 lakh mark.

Meanwhile, Shows for other regional dubbed versions of Ramayana Part One should open in the coming week as the rollout date approaches close. As per the latest buzz, the makers are negotiating with theatre owners for revenue share, which may have delayed the wider rollout of the movie’s advance bookings. Sacnilk reports that four shows - two in Telugu and two in Hindi - are already houseful. But on ground tracking indicates that the number may be over a dozen after accounting for blocked seats.

Notably, Premium formats, including IMAX and 4DX, are driving the advance booking sales for Ramayana so far. IMAX shows are only 3.8% of the total shows in India for the movie, but have still accounted for almost 25% of the earnings so far. According to the available date, the regular shows have sold 1.5 lakh tickets in over 4100 shows. This gives these shows an average of around 35 tickets sold per screening so far.

As per the latest buzz, In comparison, the IMAX shows have sold over 23K tickets in 140 shows, with an average of 170 tickets sold per screening. This is almost 5 times the rate of tickets sold for the regular shows. IMAX screenings have managed this despite having an average ticket price of ₹ 1095, as opposed to ₹ 380 for regular screenings. Other formats like 4DX, ICE, and DOLBY CINE have also sold over 12K tickets across languages so far.

In further updates, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

On top of that, Sony Pictures will handle global distribution, excluding India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the movie in the Hindi-speaking market. The movie is also planned for a worldwide IMAX rollout.

title: Saif Ali Khan attack trial begins, nurse says intruder demanded ₹1 crore, recalls actor overpowering him
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Saif Ali Khan was attacked by an intruder at his Mumbai home on the night of January 15-16 last year. As the trial in the case began on Friday, the 59-year-old nurse, who has worked as a staff member looking after Saif and Kareena Kapoor's younger son, Jeh , for over five years, identified 31-year-old Mohammed Shariful in court as the intruder who entered the couple's Bandra home during an attempted robbery.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan was attacked by an intruder at his Bandra home last year. (PTI) Intruder demanded ₹ 1 crore rupees: Nurse The nurse also recounted what happened that night and how the intruder demanded ₹ 1 crore rupees. According to The Indian Express, she is the complainant and the first witness in the case. She recalled being woken up by a sound around 2 am. She noticed that the bathroom light was on and assumed it was Kareena Kapoor Khan. However, when she woke up again, she saw the shadow of a man moving towards the bed of Saif and Kareena's younger son, Jeh.

Meanwhile, When she ran towards Jeh's bed and tried to pick him up, the man attacked her with a hacksaw blade and told her to keep quiet. During the court proceedings, she recalled that he demanded money, saying, “ ₹ 1 crore rupees”. The noise also woke Jeh's nanny, who came out and raised the alarm. Hearing the commotion, Saif and Kareena rushed out of their rooms, and Saif asked the intruder who he was and what he wanted.

Notably, The man then attacked Saif. Another staff member was also attacked by the intruder. However, the nurse recalled that Saif managed to overpower him while they ran into another room and locked themselves inside. By the time other staff members arrived, the intruder had escaped. Saif suffered serious injuries and was rushed to hospital.

As per the latest buzz, In an earlier interaction with Mojo Story, Saif had opened up about the attack and recalled how, after sustaining knife injuries, he felt he might die. He also spoke about wanting to be with his son, Taimur, at that moment and how the incident affected him.

In further updates, He shared, "I was white kurta pyjama covered in blood, and at one point, I was lying on the floor, I thought I might die. At that point, I really wanted to be with Taimur and I asked him if he will accompany me to the hospital, and he asked me, 'are you going to die?' I told him no and we went to the hospital together. I even wanted to forgive this guy because I think he made a huge mistake, and I think he was not looking for a fight. I would be happy to forgive him, but that part where he tried to kill me is something that I am finding hard to let go. It’s a question of haves and have not and it is the inequality that has led to this."

On top of that, Following the incident, Mumbai Police arrested the accused, Mohammed Shariful Shariful, three days after the attack. The case has since proceeded to trial after the court rejected Shariful’s second attempt to plead guilty.

title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE: INDIA bloc to hold CEC's ‘public impeachment’ on Oct 30, ‘Dilli Chalo' march on Nov 1
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi with India bloc leaders and Congress workers and supporters during ‘March for Democracy’ to the Supreme Court, to file a petition against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on October 12, 2026. Anti-CEC protest LIVE: The opposition INDIA bloc is set to stage a “public impeachment” of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on October 30, followed by the announcement of a public verdict against him. The event, described as a “mock Parliament”, will take place at Hotel Ashok and is expected to bring together opposition MPs and senior leaders from across the bloc. ...Read More

Adding to this, On November 1, the opposition will take its campaign to the streets with a ‘Dilli chalo march’ to Ramlila Maidan, Congress general secretary KC Venugopal revealed. The bloc has billed the march as its “biggest” mobilisation against a alleged “vote chori”, PTI reported. Amit Shah reviews Delhi's law and order Union home minister Amit Shah visited the Delhi Police headquarters on Saturday afternoon to review the national capital’s law and order situation. According to sources cited by news agency PTI, the Cockroach Janta Party's recent demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar were expected to be among the issues discussed with senior police officials. CJP leaders say they would continue protest against SIR of electoral rolls The CJP leaders have vowed to continue their movement against the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka on Saturday shared no bond could stop people from protesting. “No bond bars our constitutional right to protest, unless of course Paw-Paw is planning to change the Constitution,” Ranka shared in a post on X. CJP co-convener Saurav Das also launched a fresh attack on CEC Gyanesh Kumar, claiming his “days are numbered.” Das shared. “Unfortunately, the most dishonourable men are in positions of power in our country today. But. Their time is up." Legal trouble for the two CJP leaders began on October 13 when they along with Ajinkya Shinde and 10 other CJP members scaled an iron gate and entered Jantar Mantar, which was by then de-notified as a protest site. On Wednesday, the special executive magistrate ordered the rollout of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from judicial custody after they agreed not to call any protests at Jantar Mantar until the site is re-notified as a designated protest site. Neha Bora refuses to sign peace bond Meanwhile on Saturday, AISA's Neha Bora refused to sign a peace bond a day after the Delhi high court dismissed her plea challenging a police notice which directed to execute a ₹ 10,000 personal bond with the surety to maintain peace. Bora disputed the evidence presented by the cops, while claiming that the Central Park protest, which was cited in the police notice as evidence, was not called by AISA. 57 FIRs registered over protests in Delhi Delhi Police have registered 57 FIRs over protests in the capital demanding the resignation of CEC during October, with all the cases transferred to the Crime Branch for investigation, officials aware of the matter shared on Friday. The transfer follows a decision by senior police officers that all protest-related cases would be investigated by specialised units rather than district police, HT learnt. The demonstrations against CEC flared after an investigative report by The Indian Express that claimed Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months regarding decisions taken by the poll body, including those linked to SIR. The Election Commission, however, rejected these allegations, saying that major decisions had been taken unanimously by the full commission.

Meanwhile, Anti-SIR protest LIVE: The Congress has asserted that the INDIA bloc's November 1 rally in Delhi against "vote chori" will send a strong message that "we are united" in protecting democracy and driving the "vote chors" out of power.

Notably, Anti-SIR protest LIVE: On the Congress rally planned for November 1 at Ramlila Maidan, Bengal minister Tapas Roy shared, “Let them talk; it doesn't matter... You should also take note of the progress our country is making across every sector and department.”
As per the latest buzz, “As Indians—and perhaps as nationalists—you must ensure that they do not succeed in their attempts to weaken the nation,” he told reporters on Saturday.

In further updates, Anti-SIR protest LIVE: KC Venugopal shared that Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge has contacted all INDIA bloc parties for their presence in Delhi on the two days. (October 30 and November 1).

On top of that, On Saturday, the Congress leadership held internal meetings with heads of its frontal organisations and Delhi unit leaders and discussed plans to make the November 1 INDIA bloc rally and march at Ramlila grounds a grand success.
“No bond bars our constitutional right to protest, unless ofcourse Paw-Paw is planning to change the Constitution,” Ranka shared.

title: Naseeruddin Shah backs protesting students at SRFTI, accuses BJP of trying to ‘brainwash, frighten’ future filmmakers
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

National Award-winning star Naseeruddin Shah has backed the protesting students at the Satyajit Ray Movie and Television Institute in Kolkata, while launching an all-out attack on the BJP led government in West Bengal.

Adding to this, Naseeruddin Shah has lent his support to the protests at Kolkata's SRFTI. (PTI Photo) (PTI) Naseeruddin Shah backs SRFTI students On Saturday, the veteran star took to social media to share a video messaging supporting the SRFTI students, who are on a sit-in over alleged campus violence and demanding the resignation of the Vice Chancellor Santosh Ajmera.

Meanwhile, The star also alleged the party of trying to brainswash and frighten future filmmakers. “This BJP, not content with backing and encouraging shameless propaganda in its favour, is now hoping either to brainwash or frighten the future filmmakers of this country, and I can promise you that is not going to happen. These are the young people who in the future will tell us the truth about themselves and about our country and about the state we are in. I urge all right-minded citizens to support the demands of the Satyajit Ray Movie and Television Institute students,” he added in the video.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Naseeruddin Shah (@naseeruddin49)

As per the latest buzz, Naseer isn't the first person from the movie fraternity to back the protesters at the SRFTI. Earlier, filmmaker Payal Kapadia , too, had posted a video backing the students and saying she was horrified by the alleged violence that took place in the campus.

In further updates, On October 4, the institute shared that a group of persons from outside the campus gathered near the main gate of the Institute and created disturbances, which disrupted the security environment of the Institute. SRFTI shared that a formal complaint regarding the incident has been filed with the concerned authorities. The students allege that the violence was orchestrated by members of the RSS. The students have been protesting for action against the alleged perpetrators since, and also demanding the resignation of vice chancellor Santosh Ajmera.

On top of that, Earlier, on October 1, VC Santosh Ajmera, called the alleged events of September 27 unfortunate and shared that students are at the heart of the Institute, and their safety, dignity, well-being and academic journey remain the foremost priority. He shared that there can be no justification for violence within an educational institution. He assured students and their families of the Institute’s firm commitment to their safety and well-being.

The Institute also shared it was extending full cooperation to the concerned authorities and following due process. All necessary measures are being taken to strengthen campus safety and security and to ensure that such an incident does not recur.

title: Freida Pinto is impressed Indian films, TV now show ‘imperfect’ women and not just those who are ‘puritanical’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Freida Pinto shared that India has changed in many beautiful ways since she made her debut with Oscar-winning British movie Slumdog Millionaire in 2008 and now there is more representation of women who are not "just duty-bound or puritanical".

Adding to this, Freida Pinto opened up about the representation of women in Indian storytelling. Pinto is one of the nine prominent Indian women who have been featured in the 2027 Pirelli Calendar, along with star Aditi Rao Hydari, musician Anoushka Shankar, poet Rupi Kaur, model Lakshmi Menon and television host Padma Lakshmi.

Meanwhile, The calendar, which was launched in Delhi on Friday, features works by photographers Raghu Rai, Avani Rai, and Solve Sundsbo and puts India at the centre of the project for the first time in its history.
Notably, Pinto, who posed in a dark pink dress under a flower-laden bougainvillea for Sundsbo, shared that the representation of women in movie and television has changed in the last nearly 20 years.

As per the latest buzz, "It has changed in many beautiful ways and there are some changes that are very, very welcome, which is, as far as I'm concerned, is the representation of women in movie and television. Being able to see all kinds, not just the duty-bound or the puritanical women, but also the ones with their complexities and not perfect," she told PTI at the launch.
In further updates, "I'm more interested in the things that are not perfect. The things that are perfect are boring and are not relatable," she added.

On top of that, The star, also known for starring Hollywood hits such as Rise of the Planet of the Apes, Immortals, and Woody Allen's You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger, shared that she hoped to see "an explosion of creativity" in the country where the youth are "so forthcoming with ideas and the desire for change".
"Ideas lead to a lot of creativity. And I hope we see a lot more of that. I hope it doesn't get stunted. I hope it doesn't get shunned or suppressed. I hope we just see it explode," she shared.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The last two years have seen several firing incidents targeting major celebrities from the Hindi movie industry, including Salman Khan, Rohit Shetty and, most of late, Tiger Shroff . Rohit, who has never spoken publicly about the attack at his home, indirectly addressed it during his recent appearance on Bigg Boss 20.

Adding to this, Rohit Shetty addressed the firing incidents targeting Bollywood celebs. (Sunil Khandare) Rohit Shetty addresses firing incidents On the latest episode of Weekend Ka Vaar in Bigg Boss 20, Rohit replaced regular host Salman Khan for the hosting duties. There, he pulled up contestants Scout OP, Asif and Yung DSA for repeatedly targeting Qazi Touqeer as a group.

Notably, On February 1, at least five rounds were fired at the first floor of Rohit Shetty’s residential building in Mumbai in the early hours of the day. No injuries were reported, and Mumbai Police later arrested several accused in connection with the incident. Bigg Boss 20 host Salman Khan also saw assailants fire at his Bandra apartment last year. The star has received several threats from gangster Lawrence Bishnoi.

As per the latest buzz, Of late, Tiger Shroff was also targeted in a firing incident. According to Mumbai Police, the firing took place at around 7 pm on October 18 in the Juhu area when Tiger Shroff was leaving a football club. The accused allegedly opened fire at the star’s car. Two people, including the star's driver, were injured but Tiger escaped unhurt.

In further updates, The police investigation into the Tiger Shroff firing case has opened up that the hotel room in Andheri, where the three key accused allegedly stayed, has been sealed by the authorities.

On top of that, As per sources, the Mumbai Crime Branch is also investigating allegations that the shooters practised firing at an unknown place before the incident. Investigators are also expected to recreate the crime scene with all three accused as part of the ongoing probe.

title: Manoj Bajpayee, Neeraj Pandey weren't worried about Ghooskhor Pandat title row affecting Gajab Raat, say they ‘moved away’ quickly | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ritesh Shah’s directorial Gajab Raat rolled out on Netflix this Friday. The Manoj Bajpayee -starrer is a thriller that tells the story of one night and sees a cop with no morals trying to do the right thing. But the movie wasn’t always called Gajab Raat. When Netflix first revealed it in February, its title was Ghooskhor Pandat, something that generated huge amount of online backlash, forcing the makers to withdraw all promotional material and change the title.

Adding to this, Manoj Bajpayee and Neeraj Pandey have collaborated on several shows before Gajab Raat. Manoj Bajpayee and Neeraj Pandey on Ghooskhor Pandat row As the movie releases, star Manoj Bajpayee and writer-producer Neeraj Pandey talk to Hindustan Times about the Ghooskhor Pandat row, and why they were unfazed by it.

Meanwhile, Gajab Raat releases eight months after the row that led to threats, trolling, and even court cases against the makers. But Neeraj Pandey maintains that he never felt the row would dominate the chatter around the movie when it releases. When asked if he was nervous about what the movie would be known for, the filmmaker shared, “Not really, because we moved away from that touchpoint. We made it very clear that it is completely unrelated to whatever the chatter was. We wanted the movie to be seen as it was and as we had set out to make it.”

Notably, Contrary to what many believe, Gajab Raat was not postponed due to the row. “ It was not supposed to come out on any other date but October 23, by the way,” Neeraj adds. Star Manoj Bajpayee explains that the original title announcement took place as part of Netflix India’s 2026 slate launch, when the movie was still in production. “The whole episode happened when Netflix revealed its slate. That was not necessarily our time to rollout it. We were still in post-production,” he explained. Talking about his expectations from what the audience takes away from the movie, he shared, “Our focus is the movie and we want people to watch it the way it is. That is how it should be.”

As per the latest buzz, Neeraj Pandey also shared he feels the movie itself has moved on from whatever happened and people understand that the row was just unfortunate. “It is evident from the trailer that it has nothing to do with what was perceived,” he shared.

In further updates, Directed by Ritesh Shah and produced by Neeraj Pandey's Friday Storytellers, Gajab Raat follows Ajay Nirvit, a cop whose act of compassion towards an injured woman draws him into a high-level conspiracy and a deadly game that unfolds over a single night.

On top of that, Gajab Raat also stars Divya Dutta, Saqib Saleem, Shraddha Das, and Akshay Oberoi, with Kiku Sharda and Nushrratt Bharuccha in special appearances. The movie is currently streaming on Netflix.

title: Radhika Apte doesn't want to be part of violent films, says she doesn't get how people eat popcorn while watching skulls being broken on sinks
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Radhika Apte has made a name for herself playing diverse roles across genres. In a career spanning almost two decades, the star has avoided being typecast, while trying her hand at almost every genre in cinema. She is, however, averse to extremely violent films, saying she wouldn’t want to be part of the currently popular mass action genre.

Adding to this, Radhika Apte will be seen next in the Netflix gangster drama, Akka. Radhika Apte on violence in films Radhika is currently promoting her soon-to-release Netflix series, Akka, which is about the rivalry between two gangsters. Talking about violence on screen, the star told PTI, “what is working right now is violence, and I'm vehemently against it. So, it's a tricky situation.”

Meanwhile, Radhika shared that centred on violence appear to be driving theatrical business, a trend she is reluctant to be part of. She explained, “I don't watch those films; I find them absurd. Like, I don't understand how one can watch and eat popcorn while 50 men or women are getting beaten up, and creatively beaten up, because last time he broke his skull on a sink, so this time let's break it on some other slab, I can't compute it. So, I'd rather not be a part of it.”

Notably, The 41-year-old added that her priorities regarding work are different after becoming a mother and that primarily includes reasonable working hours. “All I ask for is 12 hours of workday and not a 16-hour workday or like some time off, and it's not always possible. I also wanted to not work because nothing was worth (doing it). For me, I wanted to be with her as much as possible, and I still do because she's too small. So, I think all those things and my work is not my life. It has never been my life; it's part of my life. So, things are ever changing. Tomorrow I might stop doing everything, or I might do a lot. Who knows? So, it's not like there's one reason necessarily (for not doing films),” the star added. Radhika gave birth to her daughter in 2024.

As per the latest buzz, Radhika is now awaiting the rollout of her show, Akka, a 1980s-set gangster drama. It also stars Keerthy Suresh in the lead alongside Radhika and is set to premiere on October 30 on Netflix.

In further updates, The series features Tanvi Azmi, Mahesh Manjrekar, Anshuman Pushkar and Monica Panwar in key roles alongside the two leads. Akka is the latest project to come out of the collaboration between Netflix and YRF Entertainment.

title: Exclusive| We hope to move back home next year: Talat Aziz
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran ghazal singer and star Talat Aziz l ost treasured possessions, paintings, musical instruments and other belongings in a fire that broke out at his home on October 2. The blaze gutted the ground floor and parts of the first floor, leaving Aziz and his family hospitalised and facing significant losses.

Adding to this, Talat Aziz Now staying at a friend’s apartment, Aziz says the family has begun restoration work and hopes to return home early next year. “Restoration has already begun. Hopefully, by January or February, we hope to move back into our own home. The family has been coping bravely. My wife, Bina Aziz, is a very strong person, and both my sons have also been strong, ” he says.
Meanwhile, Aziz adds that a close friend living abroad has offered the family a place to stay. “We can never thank them enough. I am also thankful to the many friends who kindly offered to host us.”

Notably, While the loss of paintings and musical instruments has been heartbreaking, the 69-year-old says the family is learning to move on. “They had a lot of sentimental as well as monetary value, but we have come to terms with it. One has to get on with life, and we are grateful to God that we escaped without any injuries. That is crucial,” says Aziz who played star Hrithik Roshan’s father in the 2024 movie Fighter.

As per the latest buzz, The outpouring of support from well-wishers has also been a source of comfort. “We have received thousands of messages of support from all over the world, as well as from Mumbai and across India. I can never thank people enough. Maybe this was a reset button in our lives for the better. We have faith in the Almighty,” he ends.

title: Activist Amit Bhatnagar ends 27-day protest against Ken-Betwa link project on Madhya Pradesh Congress leader's request
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Activist Amit Bhatnagar on Saturday ended his 27-day protest against the Ken-Betwa Link Project after senior Madhya Pradesh Congress leader Umang Singhar visited Panna and assured him of the opposition party's support.

Adding to this, Tribal farmers and villagers affected by the Ken-Betwa Link Project, under the leadership of Bhatnagar, have been staging a protest for the past 42 days. (Instagram/@iamitbhatnagar) Bhatnagar ended his stir by having coconut water at the request of Singhar, the leader of Opposition in the Madhya Pradesh Assembly.

Meanwhile, Tribal farmers and villagers affected by the Ken-Betwa Link Project, under the leadership of Bhatnagar, have been staging a protest for the past 42 days demanding compensation and rehabilitation, among other demands. The protesters have raised issues related to displacement, proper rehabilitation, alleged irregularities in compensation, and violations of the Forest Rights Act.

Notably, Taking part in the 'Save the Constitution, Save Democracy' march organised by the project-affected people, who submitted a memorandum at the Collectorate, Singhar shared the Congress will always lend strong support in their fight for rights, justice, dignity, and fair compensation.

As per the latest buzz, "The BJP government, which considers tribals, Dalits and farmers as orphans, should remember that the Congress is still alive. The Congress will continue to fight for the rights and justice of the affected families, from the streets to Parliament. No family should be subjected to injustice in the name of development," he shared.
In further updates, Singhar shared he had raised the demands of the protesters in the assembly after visiting them on July 14.

On top of that, "Chief Minister Mohan Yadav had directed a resurvey of the affected families and an investigation into the status of compensation. But no concrete action has been taken by the government so far. Where is the report of the re-survey? How many of the left-out families have been compensated, and how many are still awaiting payment?" he shared.
The MP government must address the problems of the affected families in a timely manner instead of just making announcements, Singhar added.

title: Irrfan ran 200 metres despite cancer diagnosis during Blackmail shoot, told director Abhinay Deo that he might fall if he did one more take
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Director Abhinay Deo is among the lucky ones who got to work with late star Irrfan . The two worked together in the 2018 dark comedy Blackmail. In a recent interaction, Abhinay spoke about Irrfan's commitment and how the star gave his all to the role, running 200 metres despite being diagnosed with cancer and undergoing treatment.

Adding to this, Irrfan was diagnosed with cancer in 2018. 'His performances flowed like water' In conversation with SCREEN, Abhinay shared that Irrfan took on the physically demanding scene despite being unwell and ran almost 200 metres without stopping for a single shot in Blackmail. The star even did two retakes of the same shot. The director shared he did not know about Irrfan's health condition at the time.

Meanwhile, He shared, “There are so many things about him. He was an extremely spontaneous star, one of the finest our country has ever had. He used to study his characters extensively, but you could never tell that he had done so much preparation. You never got the feeling that he was performing something he had rehearsed. His performances flowed like water. He was so spontaneous, and it was fabulous to watch him.”

Notably, He added, “I told him, ‘See, Irrfan, if we manage in this shot then great, otherwise, we will have to retake the scene.’ He shared, ‘Yes, we’ll do.’ He still didn’t tell me that he isn’t well. He did once, did the second time, and in the third attempt, I shared, ‘Let’s do one last take for tighter frames.’ And, Irrfan shared, ‘Abhinay, this is the last take because after this, I might fall.’ I got shocked, and thought maybe he is tired because it was in the middle of the night. A few days later, I got to know that he is (diagnosed with cancer)…this was the commitment level, that guy just ran and ran in that state. These memories are truly special because they remind me of a great man at work, someone who was completely dedicated to his craft”

As per the latest buzz, The director shared that towards the end of the movie, he and Irrfan even discussed a sequel. However, the director shared that at that time ‘Irrfan knew that his days werenumbered.’ The star decided to revisit the conversation after his treatment. However, while the movie's rough cut was being put together, his health worsened.
In further updates, Irrfan battled a neuroendocrine tumour. He died on April 29, 2020, at the age of 53, two years after Blackmail was rolled out in theatres.

title: Amrita Puri says she has no regrets about taking break from acting to pursue master's, reveals parents were against her becoming an actor
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Amrita Puri made her Hindi movie debut with the 2010 movie Aisha , in which she played a supporting role alongside Sonam Kapoor . After her debut, Amrita starred in some projects before taking a break from acting to focus on her studies. In a recent interaction, she opened up about her decision to step away from films and shared she has no regrets about putting her education first.

Adding to this, Amrita Puri spoke about taking a break from acting. ‘Does she even live here anymore?’ Speaking on The Shaili Chopra Show, Amrita shared that she moved to the UK to pursue her master's degree at the University of Edinburgh after taking a two-year break from acting. Recalling how people reacted to her absence, she shared, “I stepped away and I did my masters. I moved and went to a different country. I was unavailable for two years and people were like, 'She is not acting anymore'. 'Does she even live here anyore?' It's a choice and it is true, you can't have everything in life. You never really know whether it was the best choice or the right choice. And often you do wonder. 'What if?' I am the queen of that. But you still got to trust yourself, like whatever is meant will come your way and you should go with your gut.”

Meanwhile, Amrita acknowledged that taking a break may have meant missing out on some opportunities in films, but shared she has never regretted her decision. She also opened up that her parents were initially against her becoming an star and that she understood the uncertainty of the profession before choosing it.

Notably, She shared, “Decisions that I have taken have made me who I am. My parents did not want me to become an star when I started acting. I knew that it is an unrelieable profession and I may fail, but I decided to do it anyway. And then if I wanted to masters, I will go anyway. I don't care if I am oldest person in the classroom. If people forget me in the movie business, I will come back and take it from there. And it's these things that build your confidence and give you a sense of identity.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Shaili Chopra Show (@shailichoprashow)

In further updates, Amrita made her acting debut with the romantic comedy-drama Aisha (2010), which collected her the Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance and a Filmfare Award nomination for Best Supporting Star. She went on to star in Mahesh Bhatt's Blood Money (2012) and gained wider recognition with the 2013 buddy sports drama Kai Po Che, which also starred Rajkummar Rao and Sushant Singh Rajput.

On top of that, She later appeared in Kangana Ranaut and Rajkummar Rao's Judgementall Hai Kya. Amrita also built a presence in the web series space, with credits including Four More Shots Please!, Made in Heaven, Mentalhood and Jeet Ki Zid.

She was last seen in the critically acclaimed series IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack, directed by Anubhav Sinha. The show featured Vijay Varma, Naseeruddin Shah, Pankaj Kapur, Dia Mirza and Arvind Swamy in key roles.

title: Sumo Didi review: This sweet, simple story about India's first female sumo wrestler entertains and inspires
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sometimes, you don't want to watch an action oriented movie while chilling at home. Not even a romance coded movie. And a web series? That's a long term commitment. Sumo Didi is the movie for such a day. Simple and easy to settle into. Isn't that appealing in itself?

Adding to this, Shriyam Bhagnani stars as Hetal Dave in the movie. The premise Directed by Jayant Rohatgi, the movie is based on the real life story of Hetal Dave, India's first professional female sumo wrestler. It traces her journey as she battles body shaming from a young age, almost gives in to the idea of undergoing liposuction, only to eventually realise that the very thing she has been conditioned to see as a weakness is, in fact, her greatest strength.

Meanwhile, Sumo Didi follows the most basic template of a biopic, with the familiar beats of struggle, self discovery and eventual triumph. The real beauty, however, lies in how the characters are fleshed out along the way. Take Anubha Fatehpuria and late Nitesh Pandey, who play Hetal's on screen parents. It would have been easy to relegate them to familiar archetypes: the supportive father who believes in his daughter and the apprehensive mother who worries about what society will say. Instead, their performances feel remarkably natural, lending the family dynamic a sense of lived-in warmth. Their concerns and affection come across as those of parents navigating unfamiliar territory, rather than characters written to serve a biopic.

Notably, That restraint also shows in the movie's treatment of body shaming and body positivity. The screenplay doesn't stop every few minutes to lecture the audience about accepting oneself or challenge society's obsession with conventional beauty standards. Instead, it allows Hetal to live her life and discover her own strength. Her journey becomes the message, without the movie feeling the need to spell it out at every turn. It is a refreshing approach, particularly for a story that could easily have slipped into heavy handed messaging. But later, as the movie crosses the halfway mark, the same simplicity begins to wear down the story.

As per the latest buzz, The performances are good across the board. Shriyam Bhagnani does a commendable job as Hetal, bringing sincerity to a character whose journey requires her to convey vulnerability as well as determination. Chaitanya Sharma, playing her biggest support system, is equally effective, with an ease on screen that makes their equation believable. The supporting cast, too, contributes to the movie's charm.

In further updates, Overall, Sumo Didi's storytelling remains fairly predictable, and those familiar with the genre will likely anticipate its narrative turns. But not every movie needs to surprise you with an unconventional structure or keep you hooked through twists and turns. Sometimes, a straightforward story told with sincerity is enough. Sumo Didi is one such movie. It has its heart in the right place, doesn't overburden its audience with manufactured drama. For a laid back movie night, that is a good reason to press play.

title: Gajab Raat review: The night in this Manoj Bajpayee-starrer should have been more eventful and exciting
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Manoj Bajpayee ’s latest, backed by filmmaker Neeraj Panday’s banner, had stirred up quite the storm when it was revealed. Not because of its cast or premise, but because of its title. Initially called Ghooskhor Pandat, the movie has now, by some strange twist of logic, been rechristened Gajab Raat. Ironically, the new title is far more apt for the movie than the original one.

Adding to this, Manoj Bajpayee stars as a cop in this crime thriller. The premise The story revolves around a corrupt police officer Ajay Nirvit (Manoj) who heads out to conduct a hotel raid but finds himself unwillingly embroiled in a case involving a girl who has been assaulted and found on the streets of Delhi. The news goes widely shared on social media. His job seems simple enough: rush the girl to the hospital and record her statement once she regains consciousness. Things get complicated, however, when a CBI official begins pressuring him to hand over the case. Our protagonist operates in a comfortable little moral grey zone, where accepting bribes for dirty jobs is all part of the daily routine. But will he bend the rules this time, too, or will something resembling a conscience finally kick in?

Meanwhile, Gajab Raat begins by teasing a morally murky thriller, and, for a while, it delivers. The tension is taut over the first 30 minutes, as director Ritesh Shah, along with writers Neeraj Pandey and Deepak Venkateshan, build a world where the price for fixing a case is already decided, and even ₹ 5 crore rupees is considered too little. The movie establishes its corrupt ecosystem effectively, making you curious to see just how deep the rot goes.

Notably, Manoj's transition from a corrupt cop who is perfectly comfortable playing by his own rules to someone determined to ensure that this particular case gets justice is handled well. His decision to side with the victim after learning the truth gives the story a compelling turn, and Manoj makes the most of it.

As per the latest buzz, The trouble begins once the movie moves past that promising first half hour. We learn that the victim stumbled upon something she was never supposed to discover, but the big reveal is less impactful than the buildup suggests. What should have raised the stakes instead leaves the narrative struggling to recapture its tension. The climax, meanwhile is too convenient to be genuinely satisfying, tying things up with an ease that feels at odds with the murky world the movie initially shows you. Also, there's a track between Manoj and Nushrrat Bharuccha (who plays an escort in the movie), which leads nowhere. Same goes for Saqib Saleem's character.

In further updates, Its really then left to the acting to make this a one time watch. Manoj is the force that drives this thriller; watch out for him in the scenes where he speaks to his seniors, convincing them to not take him off this case. He knows just how to toe the line but get what he wants by the end of any conversation. Its this shape shifting aspect that Manoj gets just right. Divya Dutta as the dirty politician is effective. Akshay Oberoi as Navin Madhok and Rajiv Gupta as SHO Praveen are good.

On top of that, Overall, for a movie that has already had quite the journey with its title, Gajab Raat could have done with a few more surprises in its screenplay. The premise is promising and Manoj Bajpayee makes for a compelling leading man. But once the initial intrigue wears off, the movie struggles to keep you invested. A decent one time watch, then, though the night could have been considerably more eventful.

title: Jamia Millia Islamia moves classes online, cites ‘safety of students' amid ongoing protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Delhi's Jamia Millia Islamia university has shifted all courses to online mode amid ongoing campus protests demanding the restoration of the students’ union, which was dissolved in 2006. In an official statement issued on Saturday, the university shared the decision was taken to ensure the safety and security of “bonafide students”.

Adding to this, Security personnel keep vigil as students of Jamia Millia Islamia amid the ongoing protests at the university. (PTI) “In view of the ongoing situation and in order to ensure the safety and security of bonafide students in the university campus, the competent authority, JMI has decided to conduct classes of all courses of the university through online mode with immediate effect until further notice,” a notice signed by JMI registrar Mohd Mahtab Alam Rizvi, dated October 24, shared.
Meanwhile, The administration also directed faculty members to facilitate the shift to online classes by providing the necessary academic support and learning materials.

Notably, Several videos surfaced online on Saturday purportedly showing the removal of a protest camp set up by students at Gulistan-i-Ghalib garden inside the university campus, near Gate no. 7. The videos also appeared to show students being asked to disperse. HT could not independently verify the footage.

As per the latest buzz, “In the morning, dozens of professors, along with the registrar, held talks with us, but the discussions ended without any satisfactory outcome. We made it clear that the protest would continue until our demands were met,” shared 22-year-old Ebin Basil, one of the students who has been on a hunger strike since October 12.

In further updates, “On the administration’s directions, security guards removed the tent and they moved the students on hunger strike inside the Faculty of Economics building, and called an ambulance to forcibly detain us. But there are students outside the building who aren’t letting them detain us,” Basil added.

On top of that, An official source familiar with the development verified that a group of professors had met the students to persuade them to call off the hunger strike, citing concerns over their health.

Saurabh Tripathi, a student protester and secretary of the All India Students’ Association (AISA) at Jamia, shared the move is aimed at curbing the movement and discouraging more students from joining the protests, even as negotiations with a committee formed by the administration remain underway.

"The minute Vanga got the news of the delay, he made a quick decision to arrive on Diwali 2027 before anyone else took the date. Bhushan Kumar was in agreement, as he always is with Vanga, and the two people revealed the date," the source tells us further.
Meanwhile, The new date of Ramayana 2 is expected to be revealed shortly, most likely in the post-credit of the first Ramayana movie on Diwali.

title: Arunachal Pradesh: Dam protesters burn NHPC office, vandalise MLAs' houses in Pasighat
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hundreds of protesters opposing the proposed 11,200 MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) allegedly set several government offices and police vehicles on fire at Pasighat in Arunachal Pradesh's East Siang District on Friday evening, officials verified on Saturday.

Adding to this, Arunachal Pradesh chief minister Pema Khandu condemned the violence and urged protesters to talk. (ANI Video Grab ) According to officials, the Pasighat office of National Hydroelectric Power Corporation (NHPC), several government offices, one police station and seven to eight police vehicles were allegedly set on fire and damaged by hundreds of protesters claiming to represent Gen Z.

Meanwhile, The houses of ruling Bharatiya Janata Party state president Kaling Moyong and MLAs Oni Panyang and Ninong Ering were damaged, and some property was taken away by the protesters, officials shared.

Notably, "There was a 12-hour bandh on Friday from 5 am till 5 pm by some people opposed to the project. It went off peacefully in Pasighat, but after 5 pm some protesters calling themselves Gen Z insisted on continuing the bandh and blocked the highway. This caused inconvenience to people and halted traffic. The local magistrate and security forces tried to persuade them for two hours to disperse," shared Jayanti Pertin, deputy commissioner of East Siang.

As per the latest buzz, "There were several hundred of the protesters. But when they didn't disperse, the magistrate ordered the firing of tear gas shells. There was no baton charge. After that, the protesters got unruly and started pelting stones, which caused hurt to some policemen and officials," she added.

In further updates, Pertin informed that the protesters then started targeting the NHPC office, Pasighat police station and seven police vehicles, which were burnt down. Some of them damaged the houses of the BJP state president and the two MLAS.

On top of that, "Eight protesters who sustained minor injuries were later given first aid treatment at the local hospital. The situation remained tense until around 4 am on Saturday. Now it is under control," she shared, adding that no one has been arrested till Saturday noon in connection with the violence.
Arunachal Pradesh chief minister Pema Khandu condemned the violence and urged protesters to talk.

title: CINTAA faces contempt proceedings over October 20 elections; Bombay High Court seeks explanation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
A contempt petition was filed by the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE).

Adding to this, On October 22, Justice Aarti Sathe issued a show cause notice to CINTAA, stating that the material placed before the court indicated a prima facie case of wilful disobedience and breach of undertaking. The court has also restrained the association from implementing the outcome of the elections held on October 20, 2026.

Meanwhile, FWICE’s petition alleges that CINTAA failed to comply with directions issued by the Bombay High Court on September 11 and October 19. The earlier orders required the parties involved in the dispute to refrain from taking further steps that could affect the court’s directions while a Notice of Motion remained pending before the trial court.

Notably, According to the petition, CINTAA went ahead with its election process and declared the results despite these restrictions. FWICE has therefore approached the High Court seeking action over the alleged non-compliance. The federation was represented by Advocates Saveena Bedi Sachar and Ashok Shetty.

As per the latest buzz, The show cause notice, issued under Rule 9(1) of the Contempt of Courts (Bombay High Court Rules, 1994), requires CINTAA to explain why proceedings under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, should not be initiated against it. The allegations concern the purported disregard of the previous orders and/or a wilful breach of the undertaking given before the court.

In further updates, The High Court’s direction means CINTAA cannot act on the October 20 election results or give effect to them while the restraint remains in place. The notice represents an opportunity for the association to respond to the allegations; the court has not yet made a final determination on the contempt petition.
On top of that, The matter is scheduled to come up before the Bombay High Court again on November 18, 2026.

title: Udta Teer box office collection day 1: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s film opens at ₹4.10 crore, narrowly edges Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s Udta Teer opened at the ticket-window with modest numbers despite a wide theatrical rollout. The spy comedy received mixed reviews from critics and audiences and failed to draw large crowds through much of its opening day.

Adding to this, Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan's Udta Teer had a modest start by ticket-window. Udta Teer ticket-window update According to Sacnilk, Udta Teer collected ₹ 4.10 crore rupees net in India across 6,265 shows on day 1. The movie registered an overall theatre occupancy of 13% on Friday. The movie's occupancy as per reports increased to 25% during the night shows, a promising sign for the remainder of the weekend.

Meanwhile, Udta Teer arrived in theatres while Yami Gautam's Nayyi Navelli and Rajkummar Rao's Prahaar continued their runs at the ticket-window. Both films, which rolled out the previous week, have also recorded modest performances at the ticket-window.

Notably, Nayyi Navelli collected merely ₹ 60 lakh net in India on Friday, its eighth day in theatres. Prahaar, which was also running in day 8, collected ₹ 60 lakh net as well. Udta Teer was able to easily draw audiences away from them on rollout day. Nayyi Naveli saw a drop of 50% from Thursday, while Prahaar's collections dipped by 60%.

As per the latest buzz, The spy comedy has also comfortably surpassed the opening-day collections of Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui (2021) and Doctor G (2022). While Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui opened at ₹ 3.75 crore rupees net in India, Doctor G collected ₹ 3.87 crore rupees net on its first day in theatres. However, the movie remains far behind Ayushmann's highest opener - Thamma, which collected ₹ 23 crore rupees on opening day.

In further updates, Hindustan Times gave the movie 3.5 stars and wrote, “Udta Teer is the kind of comedy that makes you wish filmmakers would trust good writing a little more often. Its first half delivers the laughs without resorting to cheap tricks, and its cast is more than happy to play along with the madness. The second half could have held on to that for longer, but the movie still leaves a good impression. Bilal's loyalties may be all over the place, but the movie's intentions are clear: to entertain without insulting the audience's intelligence.”

On top of that, Udta Teer marks Aakash Kaushik's directorial debut. The movie is backed by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla, Guneet Monga, Apoorva Mehta and Achin Jain under the banners of Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment.
Apart from Ayushmann and Sara, it features a supporting cast that includes Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Suhail Nayyar, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala and Sandeep Anand.

title: Avantika Malik says Imran Khan initiated their separation, calls it the ‘death’ of the life she had imagined
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Imran Khan and Avantika Malik were together for 18 years before their relationship came to an end. The former couple, who married in 2011, eventually decided to legally end their marriage in 2019. Of late, Avantika opened up about their separation in a conversation with Soha Ali Khan , revealing that Imran was the one who first suggested that they spend some time apart. After six months of living separately, they mutually decided to get a divorce.

Adding to this, Avantika Malik and Imran Khan were married for 8 years. ‘Separating was his idea, I would have never done it’ In conversation with Soha Ali Khan, Avantika was asked whose idea it was to separate, and she named Imran. She shared, “It was him actually. I would have never done it. Probably to my own detriment, but I would have never done it. It was his decision.”

Meanwhile, Avantika spoke about the early days of their separation and described them as deeply painful. Explaining how she felt at the time, she compared the experience to a death, as she had known Imran for 18 years and had been married to him for eight years.

Notably, “It is like death. It is a death of the way you perceived your life to be, or what you imagined your life would be, or how it would play out. It's the death of probably the most intimate relationship in your life,” she shared.

As per the latest buzz, Later in the conversation, Avantika admitted that despite the disappointment over how their relationship ended, she was proud of what they had built together over the years. She shared they had tried their best for 18 years to build a family and considered it a success, whatever form that family takes today.

In further updates, Imran and Avantika began dating when they were teenagers. They got married in January 2011 and welcomed their daughter, Imaara. After years together, the couple separated in 2019 and eventually divorced. Imran Khan found love again and is curently dating star and artist Lekha Washington. The two have made public appearances together, and were of late seen participating in the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest in Delhi.

On top of that, Imran Khan returned to the screen with a cameo in Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos, which rolled out in theatres in January 2026 and later streamed on Netflix. He is now set to star in the romantic comedy Adhure Hum Adhure Tum, alongside Bhumi Pednekar and Gurfateh Pirzada.

title: Mika Singh says Daler Mehndi broke down crying after Uttarakhand minister’s onstage reprimand, CM Pushkar Singh Dhami apologised later
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Punjabi singer Mika Singh spoke at a press conference on October 23 about how his brother, Daler Mehndi , broke down after the recent incident in Uttarakhand. Daler was in the news after Uttarakhand minister Subodh Uniyal interrupted his performance at an event and reprimanded him for allegedly appearing disoriented on stage.

Adding to this, Mika Singh came out in support of his elder brother Daler Mehndi after Uttarakhand concert row. ‘He broke down crying’ Mika was among the first celebrities to speak out against the minister’s remarks following the incident. Speaking at a recent press conference, the singer shared he learnt about the row after completing his show in Surat. He tried calling Daler that night, but his brother did not answer.

Meanwhile, Mika managed to speak to him the next day and recalled that Daler broke down on the phone. He also shared he advised his brother not to accept performance offers if he was unwell. Mika added that Daler should have stood up for himself on stage.

Notably, “When I called Paaji the next day, he broke down crying because he was emotional. I hadn’t even shared anything, and he had already started crying. I told him that if your health is not good, you should not say yes. Secondly, if the minister scolded you, you should have responded at that moment. You should have shared, ‘I have not been bought, and I am not some other singer,’” Mika shared, as reported by India Today.

As per the latest buzz, According to Mika, Daler was frightened and confused by the minister’s behaviour. The singer also shared that both brothers later received a call from Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, who assured them that they would always be welcome in the state. Mika shared the Chief Minister apologised on behalf of the minister.

In further updates, “Just this morning, I spoke with my elder brother, dear friend, and someone I hold in high regard, the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, Pushkar Singh Dhami. The way he communicated with Daler paaji and me was very polite and humble. He offered an apology on behalf of the Minister. Though I told him it wasn't necessary since he made no mistake but he assured me that I and Daler Paaji will be treated with utmost respect, the next time we visit Uttarakhand,” Mika added.

On top of that, Daler Mehndi was performing at an event in Uttarakhand when minister Subodh Uniyal interrupted him mid-performance and reprimanded him for allegedly appearing disoriented on stage. “You can't even speak. How will you perform?” the minister asked Mehndi. Later, while in conversation with ANI, the minister shared the organisers had paid the singer ₹ 35 lakh for the performance.
Daler has not publicly commented on the incident so far. Mika, along with several other celebrities, has shared videos on social media expressing support for the singer.

title: Ramayana vs Dhurandhar 2: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film sells 1 lakh tickets in advance bookings, but four times slower than Ranveer Singh's blockbuster
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ticket sales for Nitesh Tiwari’s ambitious Ramayana adaptation began on Dussehra, 15 days before the movie's rollout in theatres ahead of Diwali. The long window, along with pre-rollout events in various parts of the country, are generating buzz for producer Namit Malhotra’s magnum opus. Ramayana Part One has shown solid pace in pre-sales, crossing one lakh ticket sales over 11 days before rollout. However, its pre-sales are not quite on the same level as Dhurandhar The Revenge from earlier this year, which should be a cause of concern for the makers.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor in Ramayana (L) and Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar The Revenge (R). Ramayana vs Dhurandhar 2 advance bookings Dhurandhar The Revenge had one of the most unusual rollout strategies for an Indian movie. The Aditya Dhar movie hit the screens on March 19 with paid previews on March 18 evening. Advance booking for the paid previews began on March 7, nearly two weeks before the rollout, giving it a similar long pre-sales window like Ramayana. The Ranveer Singh -starrer started on a sensational note, selling almost 1.4 lakh tickets for the paid previews in 24 hours, including 90k in the major cinema chains alone. The full advance bookings for the movie opened a week later, on March 14.

Meanwhile, Ramayana has opened the advance bookings for its Hindi version 15 days before rollout. Negotiations with cinema chains means that the pre-sales for the Kannada version have not opened fully, while the Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam version also await clarity. In four days since the advance bookings have opened, Ramayana has sold around 1.36 lakh tickets, including 87K in major cinema chains. These are the same numbers that Dhurandhar 2 achieved in just a day. Ramayana got here in four days, a much slower pace.

Notably, Dhurandhar 2 minted ₹ 40 crore rupees in paid previews alone and added ₹ 52 crore rupees net in advance bookings for its opening day. The movie had pre-sales of over ₹ 200 crore rupees worldwide before rollout, a figure that Ramayana would want to emulate before it hits the screens on November 5 ahead of Diwali.

As per the latest buzz, Ramayana has already reached the ₹ 7.74 crore rupees mark in advance bookings. The Kannada, Telugu, and Tamil versions have barely begun, contributing just ₹ 50 lakh to this figure. The Hindi version of Ramayana is showing occupancy of 15-20% in most major cities already, with almost 1000 screens open. In comparison, the Kannada version has opened in fewer than 100 screens so far and is still doing well, with some centres already reporting up to 72% occupancy for the morning shows.

In further updates, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.

On top of that, Sony Pictures will handle global distribution, excluding India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the movie in the Hindi-speaking market. The movie is also planned for a worldwide IMAX rollout.
